jobs.title: AI & Software Engineering Intern - FinTech Systems
jobs.description: **Position Overview** Our specialized financial services consulting firm has been engaged by an established financial technology and brokerage group to identify a small number of high\-potential students for its AI Engineering Internship, joining the client’s internal AI transformation team. This is not a coffee\-and\-slides internship. Selected students will work directly alongside our client’s senior engineering and department leads, contributing to production software modules, data workflows, and system integrations that the business actually runs on. The work is real, it is reviewed closely, and it ships. The focus is practical engineering: connecting systems through APIs, structuring and cleaning data, and automating internal processes such as client onboarding and the client portal. The role suits students who want to see how a financial technology business operates from the inside and who learn fastest by building. AI is at the core of how this team builds. Interns are expected to work with AI coding assistants and LLM tools every day: to design and write code, explore unfamiliar systems, generate tests, and automate workflows. Hands\-on experience programming with AI is a requirement, not a nice\-to\-have. Our client is looking for curiosity and tenacity above credentials. Students who perform well will be given increasing ownership over individual modules and a clear path toward a longer\-term engagement with the firm. **Our Client** Our client is a financial technology group serving active and institutional traders, with an established product suite spanning execution, market data, and quantitative research infrastructure. As the firm expands its institutional business, it is investing in the internal systems behind it: onboarding, client\-facing portals, data pipelines, and the integrations that connect them. This search supports that build\-out. **Location \& Format** **Location:** New York, hybrid (3 days in office, Midtown, next building from Penn Station) **Format:** Part\-time or full\-time options available **Reports to:** Department leads **Key Responsibilities** * **AI\-assisted development** – Use AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, CodeX, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of daily work to design, write, test, and document code, and build LLM\-powered steps into internal workflows where they add value * **System integration** – Design, build, and maintain API connectors between internal and external databases and systems * **Module development \& automation** – Support the development and automation of core internal modules, including client onboarding and the client portal * **Data processing \& management** – Structure, clean, and analyze diverse datasets; set up reliable database connections and keep data logic consistent across systems * **Technical collaboration** – Work directly with lead engineers and department heads to translate business logic into working code and automated scripts * **Independent problem\-solving** – Read documentation, investigate unfamiliar systems, and resolve technical problems independently before escalating **Target Candidate ProfileFields of Study** * Master’s or upper\-level Bachelor’s students in Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Physics, Computational Finance, Financial Mathematics * Ideally with a minor or concentration in Data Science or Finance **Track Record Beyond Coursework** Preference will be given to students who have shown initiative outside the standard curriculum, for example: * Math, physics, or programming olympiads * Coding competitions and hackathons * Business case challenges * Active roles in technical, quantitative, or finance student clubs **Requirements** * **Analytical rigor** – Strong mathematical foundation, logical reasoning, and a structured approach to problem\-solving * **Software \& data fundamentals** – Practical programming experience with a solid grasp of software development principles, APIs, database architecture, and data structures * **Hands\-on AI programming experience (required)** – Demonstrated experience building software with AI coding assistants and LLM tools; be ready to walk through a concrete project and explain how you used AI to build it and how you verified its output * **Curiosity** – Real curiosity about how systems and financial businesses work, evident in projects you started on your own * **Tenacity** – The persistence to work through documentation and unfamiliar codebases and to finish difficult tasks without step\-by\-step guidance * **Coachability** – Openness to direct code review and the ability to apply feedback quickly * Clear written and spoken English **Strong Plus Qualifications** * Experience building with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar), prompt engineering, RAG, or agent frameworks * Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, or integration and automation platforms * Familiarity with relational databases and basic data modeling * Personal or academic projects available on GitHub or a portfolio * Interest in markets, trading, or financial technology **What This Role Is Not** To save everyone time: this is not a quantitative research or trading position. Our client is looking for strong data skills, sound logic, and solid software engineering fundamentals. Nor is it a role for someone who treats AI tools as optional: they are central to the day\-to\-day work. Equally, this is not a passive observation role. Students who prefer well\-defined tasks with close supervision at every step are unlikely to enjoy it; those who like to take a vague problem, read up, and come back with working code will. *This search is being conducted by a specialized financial services consulting firm on behalf of an established financial technology and brokerage group. All applications will be treated in strict confidence. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for initial screening before being presented to our client.* *Note: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.* Pay: From $40\.00 per hour Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10123

jobs.title: Advanced Automation Maintenance Technician - PLC experience
jobs.description: Job Description\*\*Bring more to life. \*\* Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology? At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life. As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1\.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence. Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. The **Senior Automation Maintenance Technician** plays a critical role at Beckman Coulter Diagnostics by maintaining, troubleshooting, repairing, and optimizing high‑volume automated manufacturing equipment used in reagent production. This role provides hands‑on electrical, mechanical, and controls expertise to ensure reliable equipment performance, minimize downtime, and drive continuous improvement. Working closely with engineers, technicians, and external suppliers, the technician helps deliver exceptional equipment reliability, performance, and compliance within an FDA‑regulated manufacturing environment. This position is part of the Manufacturing Process Engineering team and will be an on\-site role, supporting our Reagent Operations facility located in Chaska, MN. **Key Responsibilities** * Diagnose and repair highly automated production equipment (electrical, mechanical, PLC/HMI, robotics, vision, motion control) to minimize downtime and restore stable operations. * Perform root cause analysis of automation, process, and material issues, implementing corrective actions to improve manufacturing performance and reliability. * Support installation, commissioning, and qualification of new/upgraded equipment while maintaining technical documentation and collaborating cross‑functionally to enhance equipment reliability. **Essential Requirements** * Associate degree, preferably in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related field, with 6\+ years of experience including experience supporting automated manufacturing equipment. * Strong hands\-on expertise across electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, robotics, vision systems, and PLC/HMI platforms (such as Rockwell), including schematic interpretation and machine/electrical safety (LOTO, NFPA 70E). * Proven problem\-solver in fast\-paced production environments with strong communication skills and flexibility to support off‑shift or on‑call operations. **It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:** * Apply Lean Six Sigma tools, statistical methods, and data analysis to drive process improvements, quality, and equipment reliability. * Experience supporting regulated manufacturing environments, ensuring compliance with quality systems and applicable regulatory requirements. * Hold or working toward advanced automation certifications (e.g., ISA CCST, CAP) with a focus on continuous technical development. Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info. The hourly range for this role is $38\.47 \- $43\.27\. This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future. We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees. Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law. You should be proficient in: * PLC Troubleshooting Skills * plc

jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: Seifert Engineering is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Controls Engineer to oversee all aspects of Controls and Automation Systems design. The ideal candidate will have experience in developing and implementing controls systems for hydraulics, pneumatics, mechanical, robotic, and safety systems. This role includes project management of large capital projects, providing support for existing control systems, and writing both internal and external engineering specifications. The Controls Engineer will also provide guidance to technicians, conduct training, and ensure safety protocols are followed. The successful candidate will prioritize safety and take proactive measures to mitigate risks associated with control systems. As a faith\-based organization rooted in biblical principles, we strive to reflect these values in our work, relationships, and decision\-making. We expect all associates to learn, embrace, and actively model our core values through their actions, choices, and collaboration with others. This commitment is essential to sustaining our culture and achieving shared success. *This job description does not describe all activities, duties, responsibilities, or physical demands that are required of the employee for this job. Likewise, the work environment described is merely representative. Duties, responsibilities, activities, physical demands, and work environment may change at any time with or without notice.* **Key Responsibilities:** * **System Design \& Support:** Install, troubleshoot, and provide technical support for Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) and Human\-Machine Interface (HMI)\-based hardware and software systems. * **Control Systems Development:** Design and develop electrical control systems for various equipment and machinery, including defining control hardware requirements and collaborating with vendors to create cost\-effective designs. * **Customer Interaction \& Feedback:** Gather and communicate feedback to the Controls \& Electrical group about customer needs, product improvements, and new opportunities. * **Project Management:** Take ownership of all aspects of field engineering, field services, commissioning, system startup, and project handover to customers, ensuring smooth implementation of controls systems. * **Collaboration \& Design Support:** Assist and collaborate with other engineers in the design of processes, equipment, and control systems using standard engineering principles and techniques. * **Customer Negotiations:** Address and negotiate technical issues of significant impact with customers, ensuring alignment with current and future business objectives. * **System Schematics \& Documentation:** Create schematics, panel layouts, and I/O lists, and generate electrical Bill of Materials (BOM) for quoting purposes. * **Safety \& Compliance:** Evaluate safety control systems to ensure compliance with safety standards and implement necessary countermeasures to address risks. * **Troubleshooting \& Maintenance:** Troubleshoot PLC, robotic, and other automation systems, and reprogram equipment as needed for engineering changes and process improvements. * **Training \& Guidance:** Provide guidance and training to technicians and team members to ensure best practices and system proficiency. **Qualifications:** * **Educational Background:** Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, or a related field. * **Experience:** A minimum of 2 years of experience in controls engineering, including hands\-on experience with PLCs and HMIs. * **Technical Knowledge:** Experience with NEC, NFPA 70E standards, and the ability to read and interpret complex electrical schematics. Proficiency in AutoCAD Electrical is preferred. * **PLC \& HMI Experience:** Proficiency with Allen Bradley PLCs and HMIs, with a demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and support production issues. * **Safety Standards:** Knowledge of Arc Flash regulations and standards, with a track record of maintaining equipment controls and electrical systems that support manufacturing. * **Problem\-Solving:** Proven success in diagnosing and resolving issues related to electrical systems and automation technologies. * **Self\-Motivation \& Independence:** Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and manage multiple tasks effectively. * **Travel Requirements:** Willingness and flexibility to travel as needed to support fieldwork and customer needs. **Why Join Seifert Engineering?** At Seifert Engineering, we value innovation, collaboration, and professional growth. If you are passionate about controls engineering and automation systems, we invite you to join our dynamic team to contribute to exciting projects and make a significant impact in the industry. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ We are reimagining how people buy and navigate healthcare. More than 80% of Americans receive health insurance through an employer or purchase coverage through individual and Medicare exchanges. Yet the experience remains overpriced, opaque, and inefficient. We replace the traditional brokerage with an AI\-native platform built to streamline this process while helping people choose plans, find care, schedule appointments, call insurance, and fight bills. Our goal is not to build a better brokerage. It is to redefine how healthcare is bought and managed across America. **Why Join Us** =============== * **Scaling quickly:** We are growing quickly and looking for zero\-to\-one builders who want an outsized opportunity to learn and shape the company’s future. * **High impact:** Healthcare costs are rising at record rates, while the user journey has never been worse. Join us as we rebuild an industry. * **Best\-in\-class talent:** Work alongside teammates from leading tech companies including Uber, Faire, Airbnb, Rippling, Google, Forward, and Collective Health, as well as brokerage industry leaders including Newfront, WTW, Marsh, and Sequoia. Our team works together in person in San Francisco. * **Well funded:** Seed\-stage startup well funded by top VC's **About the Role** ================== Our product depends on bringing together data that has never previously lived in one system: insurance plans and networks, provider and pricing data, employer and member information, claims and medical records, and the activity generated across our own products and operations. We are looking for our first Data Engineer to build the foundation that makes this information reliable and usable across the company. This person will own the systems that ingest data from APIs, files, vendors, customer systems, public sources, and legacy portals; model it into durable representations; and make it available to our products, AI agents, operators, and business systems. This is a hands\-on role with broad ownership across the data stack. You will make early architectural decisions, build the first versions yourself, and determine where rigor matters immediately and where simple systems can evolve. You will also help define how we use AI in data engineering to acquire, interpret, reconcile, and operate data more effectively. The right candidate has strong data engineering judgment, enjoys building from zero, and is excited to work with messy healthcare data where accuracy matters. **What You’ll Do** ================== * **Build our data foundation:** Own the systems that move, transform, organize, and serve data across the company, including the data warehouse (e.g. Databricks), ingestion and export infrastructure, orchestration and scheduling (e.g. Airflow or Dagster), transformation and modeling tools (e.g. dbt), semantic layers, data catalogs, quality, and observability. * **Unify fragmented healthcare data:** Ingest and connect data from paid vendors, carriers, providers, government sources such as CMS, customer and benefits administration systems, public files, APIs, legacy portals, and our own applications. Build durable workflows for large files, changing schemas, incomplete records, and sources that were never designed to work together. * **Make the data trustworthy:** Design canonical models for plans, networks, providers, employers, members, claims, and other core concepts. Preserve historical state, lineage, provenance, and source\-specific nuance so our products, agents, operators, and customers can rely on the results. * **Put data into production:** Make curated data available wherever it creates value, including our backend, member and employer experiences, AI agents, brokerage workflows, CRM, reporting, and other operational tools. Build reliable systems for moving data both into and out of the warehouse. * **Use AI to improve data engineering:** Apply models and agents to acquire information from portals and older websites, interpret unfamiliar files, map changing schemas, reconcile conflicting sources, investigate quality issues, and automate work that has traditionally been manual. * **Set the roadmap and standards:** Work across product, engineering, brokerage, and operations to identify the highest\-leverage data capabilities, prioritize the roadmap, and decide where we need durable infrastructure now and where a simpler solution can evolve. **Who You Are** =============== * **AI\-native:** You think from first principles about how models and agents can change data engineering, from acquiring data in legacy systems to interpreting files, mapping schemas, and investigating failures. You know when to use AI, when deterministic systems are safer, and how to build the evaluations and review loops needed for trustworthy results. * **End\-to\-end data engineer:** You have built and operated production data systems across ingestion, warehousing, orchestration, modeling, quality, and serving. You are hands\-on in SQL and Python and comfortable choosing and owning the surrounding tools. * **Comfortable starting from zero:** You can turn broad goals into a clear sequence of work and take responsibility from initial design through reliable production operation. * **Comfortable with messy data:** You have worked with data from external organizations, not only clean application events. You understand temporal modeling, idempotency, schema evolution, lineage, provenance, and how to establish trust when sources are incomplete or contradictory. * **Practical architect:** You can make important technical decisions without overbuilding. You know which choices will be difficult to reverse, where correctness is essential from the beginning, and where a simple first version is appropriate. * **Operationally minded:** You think beyond dashboards and analytical queries. You are comfortable designing data systems that directly support applications, automated workflows, customer\-facing experiences, and business operations. * **Able to work across disciplines:** You enjoy working with engineers, operators, and industry experts to turn complicated real\-world concepts into clear models, interfaces, and systems.

jobs.title: Director of Technology Services CGESD 2026-27
jobs.description: **Columbia Gorge Education Service District** **Job Description** **Job Title:** Director of Technology Services **Assignment:** Technology Services **Reports To:** Superintendent **Evaluated By:** Superintendent **FLSA Status:** Exempt / Administrative **Wage:** $126,060\.00 \- $131,790\.00 Annually **JOB SUMMARY** The Director of Technology Services provides executive strategic, operational, and technical leadership for the Columbia Gorge Education Service District’s (CGESD) technology infrastructure, instructional technologies, cybersecurity, enterprise data, and regional service initiatives. Reporting directly to the Superintendent and serving as a member of the Executive Administrative Team, the Director leads the strategic use of technology to support the ESD’s mission of improving student outcomes with excellence, equity, and efficiency. The Director establishes a comprehensive, regional technology vision aligned with Local Service Plan priorities, component school districts, and contracted user needs across classrooms, offices, and schools. The position oversees department operations, directs capital replacement planning and budgeting, manages USAC E\-Rate programs, and supervises Technology Department personnel. Additionally, the Director leads enterprise data governance, Personally Identifiable Information (PII) protection, and regional technology coordination. After\-hours and emergency response duties are an expected component of exempt salaried responsibilities. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** *Essential duties of this position include the following. Employees in this position perform some or all of the following tasks. Other related duties may be assigned.* * Leads strategic and operational implementation for the Technology Department, establishing service expectations, departmental workflows, technical standards, and performance benchmarks that align with the CGESD mission, vision, and board strategic goals. * Drives the strategic application of information and instructional technology in offices, schools, and classrooms to enhance student learning and regional operational efficiency. * Supervises, evaluates, and leads Technology Department personnel (including engineers, cybersecurity analysts, database managers, and technical support staff); manages recruitment, workload assignments, professional development, and personnel matters. * Develops, manages, and monitors the Technology Department operational budget in collaboration with Fiscal Services, ensuring fiscal integrity, cost\-effective service delivery, and alignment with district priorities. * Establishes and maintains a comprehensive multi\-year technology replacement and capital improvement plan, evaluating total cost of ownership (TCO) and long\-term sustainability across hardware and software ecosystems. * Directs the district’s E\-Rate program, federal technology grants, and regional funding opportunities to maximize financial resources and cost\-sharing for CGESD and component school districts. * Develops, implements, and monitors a comprehensive enterprise information security and data risk governance plan to safeguard assets, networks, cloud computing, and Personally Identifiable Information (PII). * Ensures that all CGESD and regional district employees receive systematic, ongoing training related to cybersecurity, information security best practices, and data privacy with focused attention on PII protection. * Provides executive leadership and oversight for enterprise networking, virtualized hypervisors, telecommunications, cloud tenant environments (Azure, AWS, M365, Google Workspace), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Student Information Systems (SIS), and database applications. * Oversees enterprise backup strategies, immutable data repositories, and disaster recovery execution protocols, leading periodic continuity testing to ensure high operational resilience and business sustainability. * Provides executive advice to the Superintendent, Board of Directors, and administrative team regarding technology investments, emerging instructional technologies, information security, and technical risk management. * Facilitates regional technology governance, local service plan alignment, and collaborative committees with component school district superintendents, technology directors, and educational partners. * Negotiates systems acquisitions, software licenses, vendor contracts, and end\-user service agreements in accordance with district procurement guidelines and state regulations. * Acts as executive technical escalation lead for major network disruptions, critical cybersecurity incidents, system outages, or complex inter\-agency technical integration challenges. * Coordinates with district facility leaders regarding long\-range infrastructure design, low\-voltage installation standards, and building technology systems in existing and new facilities. * Maintains accurate department documentation, inventory records, egulations. **Strategic, Analytical, and Communication Skills** * Visionary Strategic Planning: Ability to align technology investments with educational outcomes, equity, and regional Local Service Plans. + Executive Communication: Demonstrated ability to explain complex technical and quantitative concepts clearly to school boards, superintendents, and non\-technical stakeholders. + Inter\-Agency Collaboration: Skill in building regional partnerships, negotiating multi\-district service agreements, and fostering cooperative technology models. **Licenses and Clearances** * Valid Oregon Driver’s License and evidence of insurability. + Criminal Justice Fingerprint Clearance. + Successful completion of ESD background screening. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit, stand, walk, and use hands for fine manipulation, handle or feel, and reach with hands and arms using computer displays and keyboards. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, or climb stairs. Without significant risk of injury, the employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10–25 pounds and occasionally lift/move up to 50 pounds. **Physical Requirements Rating Scale:** *N \= Never (Not Present) \| O \= Occasionally (Up to 1/3 of time) \| F \= Frequently (1/3 to 2/3 of time) \| C \= Constantly (2/3\+ of time)* Stand / Walk **F** Squat / Stoop **O** Sit **C** Climb Stairs **O** Drive **O** Lifting 10 lbs **F** Single Grasping **F** Lifting 25 lbs **O** Fine Manipulation **F** Lifting 50 lbs **O** Computer / Display Use **C** Lifting 75\+ lbs **N** **WORK ENVIRONMENT** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The work is performed primarily in standard office and education service district facilities, with frequent travel required among CGESD buildings, component school districts, regional partner sites, and state training venues. The noise level in the work environment is typically low to moderate. Irregular working hours and evening/weekend duties are common, particularly during significant network outages, critical cybersecurity incidents, or major system cutovers. **OTHER** **Mandatory Child Abuse Reporting** As a mandatory reporter under Oregon law (ORS 419b.010\), you are required to immediately report to Law Enforcement and/or the Department of Human Services any instances of suspected child abuse. See ESD Board Policy for specific reporting protocols. *Note: This is not necessarily an exhaustive or all\-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, duties, requirements, efforts, functions, or working conditions associated with the job. jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description: #### **About Artisight** Artisight transforms hospital operations with its Smart Hospital Platform, helping health systems reduce costs, improve efficiency, and enhance patient care. U.S., and requires U.S. work authorization.** #### **What You'll Do** * Lead projects end to end, from internal handoff through deployment, testing, client acceptance, and closeout, reviewing SOWs, jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description: **About NANO Nuclear Energy** NANO Nuclear Energy is an advanced nuclear technology company developing next\-generation microreactor systems that will help transform the future of clean, reliable, and resilient energy. Through the development of its KRONOS MMR™ Energy System, LOKI MMR™ Energy System, and ZEUS™ Solid Core Battery Reactor—advanced high\-temperature gas\-cooled reactor (HTGR) technologies designed for applications including data centers, industrial operations, remote communities, and critical infrastructure—the company is advancing innovative nuclear solutions for a rapidly evolving energy landscape. NANO Nuclear has also submitted a Construction Permit Application (CPA) to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) to support the planned deployment of the KRONOS MMR at the University of Illinois Urbana\-Champaign (UIUC), representing a significant milestone toward the commercialization of advanced nuclear technology. Joining NANO Nuclear means contributing to pioneering technologies with the potential to redefine the nuclear industry while working alongside experts in engineering, science, and innovation. Our team operates in a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment where employees are encouraged to solve challenging technical problems and advance the materials technologies needed for next\-generation energy systems. **Overview** We are looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Assurance Engineer to assist in the development and implementation of the Nano Nuclear Energy quality assurance program as we move toward initial construction of our Kronos MMR. This position is located at our facility in Oak Brook, Illinois, reporting to the Director of Quality Assurance. You'll work independently with limited supervision, applying your knowledge to projects and processes. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact, collaborate with talented professionals, and grow your career in a supportive and innovative environment. **Responsibilities** * Quality oversight to ensure work is performed in strict accordance with requirements of the quality assurance program. * Supports supplier qualification and verification activities through performance of audits and surveillance activities. * Assists technical staff with the creation of quality plans and acceptance criteria lists, and inspection plans. * Promote Continuous Improvement and the timely reporting of all conditions that affect Quality. * Collaborate with the project team to implement quality improvements and perform causal analysis investigations on project\-related issues. * Lead and mentor personnel to ensure the correct behaviors are developed and reinforced. * Ensure compliance with environmental, safety, and health program requirements. * May perform other duties as assigned. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related field. Experience may be considered in lieu of degree. * 5 years of experience in QA/QC, with 2 years nuclear quality experience in a Department of Energy (DOE), Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC), or similar environment. * Knowledge of Quality standards such as ISO 9001, ASME NQA\-1, ASME III, ASME B31\.1, ASME B31\.3\. * Previous experience/certification in non\-destructive examination; UT, PT, RT. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to work independently and demonstrate critical thinking. * Ability to function well in a fast\-paced research environment, set priorities to accomplish multiple tasks within deadlines, and adapt to ever\-changing needs. **Preferred Qualifications** * NQA\-1 Lead Auditor Certification. * Nuclear Navy experience. * Experience with Software QA in accordance with NQA\-1\-2022, Part II, Subpart 2\.7\. * Experience with commercial grade dedication. * Knowledge of CSA N286/N299 Standards. Special Requirements * This position requires access to safety related material and facilities. As such, passing a background check and a pre\-placement drug test and participation in an ongoing random drug testing program is required. * This position may require access to radiologically controlled areas. Ability to meet all safety requirements is mandatory. * Business travel to support supplier surveys and/or company audits. **What We Offer** * A collaborative culture focused on innovation and technical excellence. * Opportunities for mentorship, professional growth, and technical leadership. * The opportunity to contribute to a cleaner, more reliable energy future. * Competitive medical, dental, vision and life insurance with generous company contributions. * 401(k) plan with a company match of up to 5%. * Unlimited PTO policy with company holidays and paid parental leave. **Equal Opportunity Statement** NANO Nuclear Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer [NYC]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== At Concurrence, we're building the clinical AI infrastructure that health systems, life sciences companies, payors, and government agencies run their patient\-facing care on. Our agents work across the whole patient journey: pre\-visit intake, care navigation, post\-visit care plans, and ongoing monitoring. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. This hasn’t been solved because the underlying record was never built for it. EHRs were designed for billing, not for systems that learn. So instead of layering another point solution on top, we’re rebuilding the medical record as a timeline of clinical events and running agents on top of it that improve with every patient interaction. Unlike single\-purpose chatbots or scribes, Concurrence is the platform our customers use to build their own agents. That means our work has to hold up across specialties, workflows, and regulatory environments and not just one narrow use case. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. Our work is validated through partnerships with leading academic medical institutions. We’re fresh off our Series A, backed by Tier 1 VCs such as Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re a small team of around 35 people, working in person in New York City and San Francisco. We care deeply about craft, clinical rigor, and the speed at which good ideas reach patients. If you want your work to be measured in outcomes rather than releases, we’d like to hear from you. **About this role** =================== As a Sales Engineer at Concurrence, you'll own the technical side of a deal from first conversation through signature. You'll work alongside the account executive with CIOs, chief medical officers, and their teams, establish what their environment supports, and build the demo that proves it. It's a hands\-on role: our sales engineers write code, and the job is to show a prospect what's possible, not only what already exists. The role exists so our Applied AI Engineers can stay focused on production deployments. You own the pre\-sales technical surface: scoping what we can do, building proof\-of\-concept agents, running technical discovery, and making the product feel real before anything is signed. You'll often be the only technical person in the room, so the role suits someone who can carry that without support. The standard we work to is that a demo should hold up as a product rather than a services engagement. We're building the team around two complementary strengths, and we'd rather someone be excellent at one than adequate at both. The first is building: you'd rather prototype five ideas in a week than polish one for a month, and you're happy being the first person to try the platform in a clinical domain we haven't touched. The second is domain depth: understanding how health systems operate, who signs, and who blocks. Over time we want coverage across the ecosystems our customers run on, including Epic, Cerner, Salesforce, and on\-premise deployments. **What you'll do** ================== * Build rapid POCs and demo environments tailored to specific prospect workflows and clinical use cases * Partner with account executives during technical discovery to scope what's possible and shape deal architecture * Design and deliver live technical demonstrations that translate prospect pain points into working agent experiences * Prototype experimental agent configurations that explore new use cases and push the boundaries of what our platform can do * Run technical deep dives with prospect clinical, IT, and operations teams to understand integration requirements and workflow constraints, including EHRs and payor systems we haven't worked with before * Create reusable demo assets and POC templates that accelerate future sales cycles * Write the reference architectures, pricing and sizing models, and persona maps our cloud and data partners need to put us in front of their field teams * Translate technical objections into solutions during the sales process, including security, compliance, and integration feasibility * Collaborate with Applied AI Engineers to hand off won deals cleanly, documenting POC learnings and customer expectations * Feed insights from the field back to product and engineering: what prospects are asking for, what patterns emerge, and where the platform should go next * Stay current on AI and LLM developments and competitor capabilities **What we're looking for** ========================== * Experience in sales engineering, solutions engineering, or a technical pre\-sales role at a SaaS or AI company, with deals you can point to and describe your own technical contribution on * Strong hands\-on coding ability. You can build a working prototype, not just talk about one, and you're proficient in Python * Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering,  run a room, presenting to technical and executive audiences, handling objections live, and thinking on your feet * Strong discovery skills: you ask the right questions to uncover real problems, not just stated requirements * Experience working deals alongside account executives, and an understanding of sales cycles and buyer psychology * Clear technical communication. You can explain complex systems to non\-technical stakeholders without dumbing it down * Comfort with ambiguity: prospects don't hand you clean requirements, and you thrive in that environment * You're low ego, direct, and hold yourself to a high bar * You can work on site in New York City **Nice to have** ================ * Experience in healthcare technology or another regulated industry * Background as a software engineer who moved into a customer\-facing role, or the reverse * Deep knowledge of one ecosystem we sell into (Epic, Cerner, Salesforce, on\-premise health systems), including how those organizations buy * Familiarity with healthcare workflows, clinical terminology, and interoperability standards such as FHIR * Understanding of healthcare compliance requirements such as HIPAA and SOC 2 * Experience building demo environments or sandbox platforms * Experience with voice agents, and the latency and quality tradeoffs in speech to text and text to speech * Experience building cloud partner motions, such as AWS or GCP marketplace listings and joint reference architectures * A track record of directly influencing deal outcomes through technical work **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas—not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $170K \- $200K

jobs.description: **Position Details** * **Employment:** Full\-time, permanent W\-2 employee. * **Location:** Fully remote within the United States; no office attendance or relocation required. * **Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 40 working hours per week. Saturday and Sunday off. * **Working hours:** Flexible start and finish times, with availability from 11:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Central Time for collaboration. Lunch breaks are outside working hours. * **Base salary:** $175,000–$205,000 USD annually, before taxes, paid biweekly. * **Reports to:** Head of Engineering. * **Travel:** None required. **About ParcelNest** ParcelNest Technologies builds software that helps online retailers manage orders, inventory, and shipping through one platform. Our team focuses on making everyday operations simpler and more reliable for growing businesses. **About the Role** You will design and develop the backend services behind ParcelNest Hub, with a focus on order processing, inventory synchronization, and third\-party integrations. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with ownership of technical decisions, from initial design through deployment and ongoing improvement. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Support to turn real customer problems into reliable software. **What You’ll Do** * Build and maintain backend services and APIs for orders, inventory, and shipping workflows. * Develop integrations with e\-commerce platforms and shipping providers, including authentication, webhooks, and data synchronization. * Design background processing that handles retries, duplicate events, and third\-party service failures safely. * Improve database performance, data integrity, and the reliability of customer\-facing features. * Own projects from technical proposal and implementation through testing, rollout, and monitoring. * Investigate production issues during working hours and address their underlying causes. * Review code, document important decisions, and mentor teammates through pairing and constructive feedback. * Work with Product to balance customer needs, delivery timelines, and long\-term maintainability. **What You’ll Bring** * At least five years of professional backend software engineering experience. * Strong production experience with Python and a framework such as FastAPI or Django. * Strong SQL skills and experience designing, maintaining, and optimizing PostgreSQL databases. * Experience building APIs and integrating with external services. * Practical understanding of asynchronous processing, message queues, idempotency, and failure recovery. * Experience deploying and supporting applications in a cloud environment, preferably AWS. * Confidence writing automated tests, reviewing code, and using logs and metrics to diagnose problems. * Clear written and spoken English and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote team. * Experience independently delivering a substantial feature or service from design to production. A computer science degree is welcome but not required. We value relevant experience and demonstrated engineering judgment. **Nice to Have** Experience with Shopify or WooCommerce integrations, fulfillment systems, multi\-tenant SaaS products, Redis, Terraform, or application observability. You do not need experience with every tool in our stack to apply. **Our Technology Stack** Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS, Docker, Terraform, and GitHub Actions. **Compensation and Working Expectations** The base salary range is $175,000–$205,000\. Your offer will reflect relevant experience, system design skills, and the level of responsibility you can take on. The same range applies across eligible U.S. locations. This is a salaried position. The stated range is base pay and does not include the value of benefits. No variable bonus or equity award is included in this sample package. Compensation is reviewed annually. We plan work around a 40\-hour week. This position does not include an after\-hours on\-call rotation or scheduled evening or weekend work. **Benefits** * **Medical, dental, and vision:** Coverage begins on the first day of the month following hire. ParcelNest pays 90% of employee premiums and 50% of dependent premiums. * **401(k):** Eligible after 90 days, with a dollar\-for\-dollar employer match on the first 4% of eligible pay you contribute. Employer contributions vest immediately. * **Paid time off:** 20 vacation days accrued annually, plus 7 paid sick days and 10 paid company holidays. * **Parental leave:** 8 weeks of paid leave after 12 months of employment. * **Life and disability insurance:** Company\-paid basic life and short\-term disability coverage. * **Remote equipment:** Company\-provided laptop, monitor, and accessories, plus a one\-time $750 home\-office allowance. * **Internet support:** $75 monthly reimbursement toward home internet. * **Professional development:** Up to $1,500 annually for approved courses, certifications, books, or conferences. * **Paid onboarding:** A structured introduction to the product, architecture, and development process, with an assigned engineering buddy. **How We Work Together** We value thoughtful engineering, clear communication, and people who follow through. You will have room to work independently, with teammates available to discuss a design or help investigate a difficult problem. We document decisions, keep meetings focused, and give feedback respectfully. Asking for help is welcome. When something breaks, we focus on understanding the failure and improving the system. You can contribute fully whether you are outgoing or more reserved. Social activities are optional, and personal time is respected. **Your First 90 Days** * **First 30 days:** Learn the product and architecture, set up your development environment, and ship an initial improvement with support from your onboarding buddy. * **By 60 days:** Own a scoped backend feature or integration improvement through design, testing, and release. * **By 90 days:** Independently lead a project and contribute a practical improvement to reliability, performance, or the development process. Success is measured by reliable delivery, sound technical decisions, maintainable code, and effective collaboration. **Hiring Process** * A 30\-minute introductory conversation about your experience and expectations. * A 60\-minute practical coding and debugging session using a small sample service. * A 60\-minute system design discussion based on an e\-commerce workflow. * A 30\-minute conversation with the Head of Engineering about collaboration and ownership. No unpaid take\-home project is required. The target process takes two to three weeks, with time for your questions at every stage. **Eligibility and Application** Candidates must reside in the United States and be authorized to work there. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. An English\-language résumé is required. A LinkedIn profile, GitHub profile, or examples of relevant work are optional; a cover letter is not required. ParcelNest welcomes applicants from different backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Pay: $175,000\.00 \- $200,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: The Senior Data Platform Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, and supporting enterprise cloud data platform capabilities. Reporting to the Sr. Director of Data Platform Transformations \& Operations, this role combines hands\-on engineering, solution design, and operational ownership to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable solutions. The engineer serves as a technical lead on major initiatives while remaining accountable for production support and operational excellence. The role supports platform transformation and steady\-state operations, with approximately 70% focused on development of new capabilities and 30% on operations, support, and platform reliability. Primary areas include Azure Databricks, cloud data engineering, platform modernization, automation, governance, and continuous improvement. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines, ingestion frameworks, transformation processes, and reusable data products using Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL, and Delta Lake. * Implement Bronze, Silver, and Gold architecture patterns supporting enterprise reporting, analytics, AI, and self\-service data consumption. * Build reusable frameworks, utilities, and platform components that improve engineering productivity, quality, consistency, and deployment speed. * Develop and support batch, near\-real\-time, and streaming integration solutions, including modernization of legacy warehouse and ETL workloads. * Serve as technical lead for complex initiatives; develop solution designs, lead technical reviews, recommend tools and approaches, and guide work through production implementation. * Partner with data architects and platform leaders to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, governed, cost\-conscious, and operationally supportable. * Mentor engineers and promote standards for coding, testing, documentation, performance, and production readiness. * Implement data quality, validation, reconciliation, monitoring, metadata, and lineage capabilities; support RBAC and enterprise security controls. * Build and maintain CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, and release processes using Azure DevOps and Git\-based practices. * Contribute to platform observability, alerting, operational dashboards, health metrics, performance tuning, and cost optimization. * Participate in production support, incident response, pager, and on\-call rotations; troubleshoot issues, lead root cause analysis, and implement durable remediation. * Create and maintain operational runbooks, support procedures, technical documentation, and knowledge\-sharing assets. * Collaborate with architecture, governance, security, analytics, application, and business teams to translate requirements into scalable platform solutions. * Support technical discovery, estimation, roadmap planning, delivery execution, and evaluation of emerging cloud, data, and AI capabilities. \* **Job Requirements** **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. * Master's degree preferred. **Experience** * 10\+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or data platform engineering. * 5\+ years of experience designing or implementing cloud\-based data warehouse, data lake, or data platform solutions. * 3\+ years of hands\-on Azure Databricks experience in enterprise production environments. * Experience with ETL/ELT development, data modeling, large\-scale integration, and cloud platform modernization. * Experience leading technical implementations, solution design, design reviews, and production releases. * Experience supporting production environments, incident response, root cause analysis, and operational support processes. * Experience in regulated, financial services, banking, or audit\-sensitive environments preferred. **Skills \& Competencies** * Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, PySpark, and Spark performance optimization. * Strong experience with Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows, and Delta Live Tables. * Strong understanding of lakehouse, Medallion Architecture, dimensional modeling, data warehousing, and analytics\-oriented data structures. * Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and deployment practices; Databricks Asset Bundles experience preferred. * Experience implementing data quality, validation, reconciliation, monitoring, metadata, lineage, governance, and security controls. * Strong technical leadership, solution design, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to independently lead complex work from design through production support and balance innovation with reliability, security, cost, and supportability. * Excellent collaboration, mentoring, documentation, and communication skills across technical and business teams. * Experience with Power BI, MicroStrategy, MDM, streaming architectures, infrastructure automation, or AI\-assisted development preferred. * Databricks Data Engineer certification at the Associate or Professional level preferred. Pay: $75\.00 \- $85\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Application Question(s): * Are you local to Austin, TX? * Are you comfortable to attend a face to face interview in Austin, TX? * Do you have strong Python Development experience along with SQL \& Databricks? * Are you comfortable to do a 90 minutes Hackerrank coding test? * Do you need sponsorship now or in future to work in the United States? Work Location: Hybrid remote in Austin, TX 78746

jobs.description: **Company Overview** Fanfix is a premier content platform dedicated to empowering creators and fostering meaningful connections with their fans. With a global community of over 7 million fans, our platform enables engagement through features like direct messaging, memberships, tipping, and exclusive content. time, bundle optimization, memory management, and frame\-rate stability. * API Integration: Proven experience integrating GraphQL or REST APIs using tools such as React Query or Apollo Client. * jobs.description: **Salary:** Starting from $113,000 per year, depending on experience **Hours:** Full\-time, Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week **Typical schedule:** 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM We’re adding a Senior Software Engineer to our Columbus engineering team to work on software used across finance, healthcare and logistics environments. This is a hands\-on senior position. You’ll spend most of your time designing, building and improving production software, while also having a genuine say in architecture, technical standards and how projects are delivered. The work is varied. Some projects involve building completely new functionality, while others focus on improving established platforms that are handling increasing numbers of users, integrations and data. What you'll be working on Projects across the team include: * Building and extending enterprise web applications * Developing APIs and backend services * Improving application performance and scalability * Modernising older services and legacy components * Integrating third\-party platforms and client systems * Improving automated testing and deployment processes * Investigating production issues and implementing long\-term fixes * Reviewing security, reliability and technical debt Most projects run through planned development cycles, so you'll have visibility of upcoming work rather than constantly jumping between last\-minute requests. **What we're looking for** You'll need solid commercial software engineering experience and should be comfortable taking ownership of technically complicated work. Strong experience with at least one of the following is expected: **Java, C\#, Python, JavaScript or TypeScript** You'll also ideally have experience with: * REST APIs and modern application architecture * SQL and database\-driven applications * Automated testing and code reviews * Git and modern development workflows * AWS, Azure or GCP * CI/CD and production deployments * Debugging live application issues Experience with React, Angular, Vue, Docker, Kubernetes or microservices is useful, but we're not expecting one person to know every technology on the list. What makes this a senior role You'll still spend a significant amount of your week coding. Alongside that, you'll review technical approaches, contribute to architecture decisions, help other engineers solve difficult problems and provide constructive code reviews. You'll also have opportunities to mentor junior and mid\-level engineers without moving away from hands\-on development into full\-time people management. **Day\-to\-day setup** The normal working week is Monday to Friday, approximately 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM, with some flexibility around start and finish times depending on the team and project. Salary starts from $118,000 per year, with the final package based on your experience and technical background. If you're a Senior Software Engineer in Columbus looking for a role where you can stay close to the code while having more influence over how software is built, we'd be interested in hearing from you. jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: ### **Description** **About ProEdge** ProEdge Dental Water Labs is a team of selfless builders. By putting our focus on the success of customers, we've created a healthy, quickly\-growing, dynamic company. Our \~50 team has taken on a significant challenge: transform compliance in the dental practice—an often distinct pain for our customers—into a culture of shared purpose for the safety of patients and staff. By building trust and developing value\-based solutions, we've created an emerging brand in dental. Because of that, "good work" is the floor here. What we're building takes people who care more about the mission than the credit, who tell the truth before it's comfortable, and who would rather be stretched by real responsibility than protected from it. **Our Values** * We build trust—by speaking candidly, doing what we say, and owning our mistakes. * We serve the team above ourselves—by choosing the mission over comfort, clarifying expectations, and engaging in feedback. * We delight our customers—by taking ownership of their experience, delivering quality they can count on, and treating every customer as valuable. * We create clarity—by making the goal plain, speaking up when we don't know, and closing the loop when clarity is at risk. * We improve—by driving our own growth, fixing the root, and making the better way repeatable. **The Software Engineer II Opportunity** Thousands of dental practices, from single offices to the largest dental groups in the country, use ProEdge's compliance platform to test their waterlines and sterilizers, see their results, and prove to inspectors that patients are safe. Our lab runs the tests. The platform is how the results reach the practice and how compliance is tracked, reminded, and reported. ProEdge is building its first in\-house development team, and this role exists to make that platform one we own end to end: understood, covered by automated tests, deployed without downtime, and fast to change. The team is two people: our Head of Technology and you. You will build with AI coding agents as the primary way code gets written, and your job is everything the agent cannot own: deciding what to build, specifying it precisely, reading every diff, proving it works, and answering for it in production. When you ship, the lab, our Customer Success team, and inside sales feel it the same week. A failed test that reaches a practice faster is a patient protected sooner. **Reports to:** Head of Technology, Kyle Crone### **Success Outcomes** * Every change to the platform ships through an automated, zero\-downtime pipeline with one\-click rollback that you and the Head of Technology can each run alone, within your first 90 days. * The compliance engine and permissions model are covered by automated tests below the browser, and the end\-to\-end suite is rebuilt in Playwright so that independent, trustworthy specs rise every month and the platform runs on one test framework by your six\-month mark. * Inside sales and Customer Success work from data and reports built for them inside the platform, with a first cut in use within 120 days. * Two legacy modules are migrated to the target stack (TypeScript, typed SQL access, React) under tests with no customer\-visible regression by month six, and the migration order is written down for the modules that follow. * Production is observable and safe: error tracking and alerting live, runbooks for the top failure modes, secrets in a managed store, and no critical or high dependency findings, within 90 days. ### **Core Responsibilities \& Role Requirements** **Core Responsibilities*** Direct AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, or whatever is best next quarter) to build, then read every diff, write the tests, and own the result in production. Nobody will ask you to prove you can type it by hand; everybody will ask how you know it works. * Migrate the platform module by module from a homegrown JavaScript front end and an untyped Express API to TypeScript, typed SQL access, and React, using the strangler\-fig pattern against live traffic. No big\-bang rewrite, no cutover night. * Write Playwright end\-to\-end tests, API permission tests, and SQL tests around a compliance engine built from stored procedures and triggers, and keep the merge gate green as the team's source of truth. * Build and own the delivery platform on AWS (App Runner, Amplify Hosting, RDS, infrastructure as code with CDK): rolling deploys, rollback, monitoring, alerting, and managed secrets. * Ship the reporting, data views, and exports the inside sales and Customer Success teams need, and sit with the people who use them. * Own the platform's integrations: HubSpot for email, NetSuite for orders, the API our largest dental\-group customers build on, and the data platform our BI team reports from. * Write it down: decision records, runbooks, and a living map of the system, plus the conventions and context files that let an agent or a new engineer be productive in the repo in minutes. * Share an on\-call rotation with the Head of Technology once production is instrumented, and be steady when it misbehaves. **Role Requirements*** Roughly three to six years shipping and operating web software people actually use. * Daily use of AI coding agents as your primary way of building, and the ability to show us your workflow live, including how you review, test, and correct what the agent produces. * Strong SQL. You can read and reason about stored procedures, triggers, and views (MySQL 8 or Postgres), and you have opinions about when logic belongs in the database. * Node.js and TypeScript on the back end (Express or similar); React on the front end. * You have inherited a codebase you did not write and left it healthier, one tested change at a time. * AWS, Docker, and GitHub Actions. Infrastructure as code (CDK or Terraform) is a strong plus. * Playwright or Cypress for end\-to\-end testing. * Security instincts: a committed secret, an unpinned dependency, or an endpoint that fails open bothers you until it is fixed. * Writing a director can follow. You will write decision records, runbooks, and short updates. * Comfortable being one of two engineers in a company of fifty: you raise problems early, propose solutions, and can stand up a small initiative on your own. * Able to work in person at our Centennial, Colorado office. * Not required: dental or compliance knowledge (we will teach you; the lab is down the hall) or a computer science degree. ### **Additional Details** **The Character We Hire For*** **Humble** – Accurately self\-aware, teachable, and quick to own their misses * **Steward** – Owns outcomes, people, and resources as if borrowed * **Discerning** – Separates signal from noise and spots the right problem * **Courageous** – Acts rightly despite fear, and steps in when it matters * **Transparent** – Shares what's real before it becomes a problem **Work Location** This is a hybrid role — 3 days a week in our Centennial office, the rest from wherever you work best. Office days are for team alignment, personal development, and collaboration.During onboarding we do require any new team member to be fully onsite, we are deliberate about investing in you and ensuring you are setup for success. Then after onboarding you'll move to our hybrid rhythm: remote Mondays and Fridays, in\-office Tuesday through Thursday. **The Hiring Process** Every hire is one of the most important decisions we make, so we put real time into this — and we'll ask real time from you. The road generally runs: Initial Interview Hiring Leader Interview Cross\-Team Panel Onsite. At the end, you'll get a clear yes or no, communicated directly. For this role there is no LeetCode and no whiteboard. Early in the process you will complete a short practical assessment on HackerRank built from real\-world tasks: a small Node service to extend, some SQL, and a code review of a pull request. An AI assistant is enabled inside the assessment and you are expected to use it, because that is how you will work here. **Salary \& Benefits** * Salary range of $125,000 to $155,000 * Employee Medical, Dental, \& Vision \+ Spouse and Dependent contributions * 4% Pre\-Tax Employer Match 401k * Accrued PTO earning up to 3 weeks annually * 1 Week of Paid Synchronized Organizational Rest at Year\-End * 6 Additional Paid Holidays * Employer\-paid short\- and long\-term disability insurance, paid life insurance **Application deadline:** October 31, 2026\. ProEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We're building a team of the right people, and the right people come from all kinds of places and backgrounds. Hiring decisions here are made on character, capability, and fit for the work—never on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or anything else unrelated to doing this work with excellence. ### **About ProEdge Dental**

jobs.description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. You’ll also have the chance to meet other students, recent graduates, and AECOM professionals from across our business lines. **On Friday, interviews will take place at our New York office.** This is a fantastic opportunity to learn about and connect with AECOM for early career opportunities. **AECOM** is seeking an **Entry\-Level Construction Estimator** for our Project Management Projects in **New York City Metropolitan Area (NY METRO)**. *This position is expected to begin in Spring/Summer 2027 or as discussed.* We take on the most complex challenges and pioneer innovative, iconic solutions that push the limits of what’s possible – the world’s longest cable\-stayed bridge, record\-breaking sports events, the largest greenfield port development megaproject, life\-sustaining and disaster recovery programs, and the tallest tower in the Western Hemisphere.
