jobs.title: Director of Construction and Field Operations
jobs.description: Position Summary The Director of DAS Construction \& Project Delivery is responsible for the end\-to\-end execution and financial success of wireless infrastructure projects, including Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS), Public Safety DAS, Private LTE, CBRS, 2\-Way Radio systems, low\-voltage cabling, and related communications infrastructure deployments. This individual will lead multiple project teams and project managers while maintaining accountability for project financial performance, execution quality, customer satisfaction, safety, and schedule adherence. The role requires an experienced leader who can bridge business strategy, operational execution, and technical expertise to successfully deliver projects across a variety of market sectors including data centers, large venues, commercial real estate, healthcare, hospitality, residential developments, campuses, industrial facilities, and mission\-critical environments. The ideal candidate is an energetic and hands\-on leader who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, is committed to continuous improvement, and consistently drives operational excellence while meeting financial and gross margin objectives. Key Responsibilities Project Delivery \& Operations Leadership Own the successful delivery of multiple concurrent DAS and wireless infrastructure projects from project award through final acceptance and closeout. Provide leadership and oversight to project managers, construction managers, field teams, subcontractors, and support staff. Develop and implement scalable project delivery processes, standards, and best practices. Ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with contractual requirements. Establish accountability across project teams while fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership, and execution excellence. Monitor project performance through established KPIs, schedules, financial reports, resource utilization, and customer feedback. Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on efficiency, quality control, customer satisfaction, and profitability. Financial Management \& Business Accountability Maintain ultimate accountability for project financial performance including revenue, cost management, forecasting, profitability, and cash flow. Own project Gross Margin (GM) targets and drive execution strategies that maximize financial performance while maintaining customer satisfaction. Review and approve project budgets, financial forecasts, change orders, procurement strategies, and cost recovery efforts. Identify project risks and proactively implement mitigation plans to protect financial outcomes. Lead monthly project financial reviews and operational performance reviews. Ensure disciplined project controls, budget adherence, and accurate financial reporting across all active projects. Take final ownership and responsibility for project financial assumptions and execution strategies during bid submission and project turnover. Estimating, Preconstruction \& Business Development Support Partner with sales, engineering, estimating, and executive leadership teams during pursuit and proposal phases. Review estimates, labor models, installation methodologies, schedules, risk factors, and execution plans. Provide constructability feedback and operational guidance during project development. Participate in bid strategy reviews and proposal development. Validate project assumptions, execution approaches, labor forecasts, subcontractor strategies, and procurement plans prior to project award. Support customer presentations, technical discussions, and executive reviews as required. Team Leadership \& Organizational Development Build, mentor, and develop high\-performing project delivery teams. Recruit, hire, train, and retain project managers, construction personnel, and operational support staff. Establish workforce development plans to support company growth and project demand. Create a culture focused on accountability, professionalism, customer success, safety, and continuous learning. Evaluate staffing requirements and develop departmental budgets aligned with business objectives. Identify opportunities to improve organizational capabilities and execution consistency. Foster a positive and collaborative work environment that supports employee growth and long\-term success. Client \& Stakeholder Management Serve as executive sponsor and escalation point for key customer relationships. Build trusted relationships with owners, general contractors, developers, operators, engineers, vendors, and strategic partners. Lead executive\-level project reviews and customer status meetings. Ensure exceptional customer experience throughout project lifecycle. Resolve complex project, contractual, operational, and customer challenges. Quality \& Execution Excellence Drive a culture of quality focused on first\-time\-right execution. Implement quality assurance and quality control programs across all projects. Ensure adherence to company standards, industry best practices, manufacturer requirements, and applicable codes. Balance project schedule requirements with workmanship standards and financial objectives. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that improve project outcomes and client satisfaction. Required Experience 10\+ years of experience managing the delivery of large\-scale wireless infrastructure and low\-voltage construction projects. 5\+ years of experience leading project management and construction teams. Demonstrated experience delivering Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS) projects from preconstruction through closeout. Experience with Public Safety DAS, ERCES, BDA systems, and NFPA/IFC compliance requirements. Experience deploying Private LTE, CBRS, and enterprise wireless systems. Experience with 2\-Way Radio infrastructure and associated network deployments. Strong background in structured cabling and low\-voltage infrastructure installation. Experience managing multi\-million\-dollar project portfolios. Proven success achieving project revenue, margin, schedule, and customer satisfaction objectives. Experience with contract administration, change order management, procurement, subcontractor management, and project controls. Demonstrated experience building and leading high\-performing project delivery organizations. Success Measures **Success in this role will be measured by:** Consistent achievement of project Gross Margin targets Revenue and profitability growth On\-time project delivery performance Customer satisfaction and retention Quality and safety metrics Team development and employee retention Forecast accuracy and financial predictability Successful scaling of project delivery operations Continuous improvement of execution processes and operational efficiency We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. jobs.description: Overview: New York Institute of Technology's six schools and colleges offer undergraduate, graduate, doctoral, and professional degree programs in in\-demand disciplines including computer science, data science, and cybersecurity; biology, health professions, and medicine; architecture and design; engineering; IT and digital technologies; management; and energy and sustainability. jobs.title: Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Implements and optimizes components within existing distributed systems under guidance. Applies basic scalability requirements, conducts performance/load testing, and configures resiliency features (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts) to handle network variability. Builds telemetry, alerts, and runbook\-driven procedures; delivers scoped features and fault\-injection tests; and helps implement basic data replication and synchronization. Assists with on\-call rotations, uses automation/IaC scripts to troubleshoot, and follows change, security, and compliance procedures (encryption, access controls, remediation plans) while escalating complex issues to senior engineers. **Responsibilities** As a Core Infrastructure Software Engineer, you will: * Design, develop, and operate highly available, scalable, and fault\-tolerant microservices across control plane, connectivity, distributed\-systems data plane, and Linux daemon technologies. * Contribute throughout the product lifecycle, from conceptualization and product definition through design, development, launch, and operational maturity. * Identify opportunities to automate engineering workflows across development, testing, troubleshooting, operations, and documentation, leveraging AI\-assisted and agentic approaches where appropriate. * Measure and improve reliability, delivery velocity, operational efficiency, customer outcomes, and engineering productivity, while sharing effective practices across the team. * You should be a hands\-on, adaptable, and self\-motivated engineer who learns quickly, applies new tools thoughtfully, and enjoys solving challenging high\-availability and scalability problems. **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of experience with systems or application development. * 3\+ years of experience with distributed systems or backend development. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related engineering field. * Proficiency with data structures, algorithms, and operating systems. * Experience with distributed systems, including familiarity with CAP theorem, consensus, messaging, and high availability. * Demonstrated willingness to learn and responsibly apply AI/LLM tools, skills, and automation to improve engineering workflows.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Platform - Nashville
jobs.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) delivers mission\-critical applications for leading enterprises worldwide. Our cloud offers hyperscale, multi\-tenant services deployed across more than 50 regions globally. OCI continues to expand beyond traditional public\-cloud boundaries to support dedicated, hybrid, and multicloud solutions, edge computing, and more. As a Principal Platform Software Engineer, you will shape the platform foundations that allow OCI services and their consumers to work together reliably at scale. You will lead cross\-team initiatives involving APIs, middleware, runtimes, integration frameworks, and developer tooling—setting technical direction while delivering durable solutions that improve consistency, compatibility, and developer experience. **This position is office\-based and requires onsite presence in Nashville, Tennessee. Relocation assistance may be available in accordance with Oracle's relocation policies.** **What You'll Do** * Lead the design, development, and evolution of backend platform services, APIs, middleware, runtimes, and integration frameworks used across OCI. * Define and drive API versioning, lifecycle, deprecation, and safe\-rollout strategies that protect downstream consumers. * Establish reusable patterns for interoperability, multi\-tenant scale, resilience, and secure software development across multiple services. * Drive shared observability practices, including service\-level objectives, error budgets, monitoring, and capacity planning. * Diagnose and resolve complex cross\-service issues; lead durable remediation and compatibility\-safe migration plans. * Influence architecture and technical decisions across teams through design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and hands\-on engineering. * Create migration guides, adoption playbooks, documentation, and examples that make platform capabilities straightforward to adopt. Mentor engineers and raise the quality of designs, code, operational practices, and technical decision\-making across the organization. * **What You'll Bring** * Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 7\+ years of professional software\-engineering experience, with demonstrated impact on backend, platform, or cloud services. * Strong experience designing highly available, scalable distributed systems and evolving production APIs or platform interfaces. * Proficiency in one or more object\-oriented or systems programming languages, such as Java, C\+\+, C\#, or Go. * Deep understanding of distributed\-systems fundamentals, object\-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, and secure software\-development practices. * Demonstrated experience leading or influencing architecture and technical design across teams. * Strong judgment in ambiguous environments, a high degree of ownership, and clear written and verbal communication skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with microservices, SDKs, RESTful APIs, containers, cloud\-native deployments, or developer\-platform products. * Experience defining or operating SLOs, error budgets, observability standards, and capacity plans. * Experience with API interoperability, backward compatibility, migrations, or platform\-adoption programs. * Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices across multiple teams

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Foundational Services
jobs.description: ARE YOU READY TO TAKE YOUR CAREER TO NEW HEIGHTS? ARE YOU SEEKING A NEW CHALLENGE IN A DYNAMIC SECTOR? This is a very exciting and highly innovative time here at Outside. OUR TRUE NORTH:Outside Interactive, Inc., the premier hub for active lifestyle enthusiasts, offers best\-in\-class content and experiences to more than 70 million of the world's most passionate outdoor, wellness, and endurance enthusiasts every month. We inspire a broad and diverse audience to do the activities they love with greater enjoyment, inspiration, and knowledge and are dedicated to making real change in the outdoor and fitness industries. Join Outside as an Engineering Manager for the Foundational Services team! You will manage 2 groups of engineers responsible for building shared services used within all products in order to provide a seamless experience. From the way people log in, update their account, and access their benefits, this team is tasked with delivering high\-quality products \& services at every touch point across our products. As a leader, your primary role is to put the goals of our customers and business first, drive product and architecture decisions with your product and design counterparts, and help your team reach its maximum potential. You'll work closely with engineering leaders across Outside to set technical strategy and direction. You are accountable for the health and execution of these services and the team that builds them and so your skillset should also be sound in architecture, feature development, and code review. **Leadership \& Culture** * Build and maintain a collaborative team culture that reflects the division's values: community \> company \> team \> individual, transparency by default, and assuming good intent and expertise from others * Foster an environment where engineers understand the business impact of their work at every level * Model good hygiene \- fix what's broken, clean up what's messy, and hold the team to the same standard * Manage conflict constructively, ensuring disagreements are resolved with low ego and a bias toward action * Work closely with the team's Product Manager to help drive the road map while maintaining scope and technical boundaries **People Management** * Run regular 1:1s and goal\-setting conversations that keep engineers aligned on expectations and growing toward their interests * Actively seek out challenging, impactful work for each engineer based on their skills and career goals, while giving them room to occasionally fail and learn * Facilitate feedback conversations early and often \- both giving and receiving * Participate in hiring to identify candidates who will strengthen the team's culture and technical capability **Cross\-Team Collaboration** * Build relationships with partner teams (Media, Mapping, and others) so that Identity \& Subscription becomes the default foundation for Outside products as they expand * Triage inbound requests from customer service and cross\-team stakeholders \- distinguishing bugs, one\-off fixes, and larger misunderstandings of platform capabilities * Communicate clearly across audiences, from engineers to product managers to senior leadership, adjusting depth and framing for each **Technical Leadership** * Engage deeply with the team's architecture and technical decisions to ask good questions, identify tradeoffs, and provide meaningful direction without needing to be in the code * Ensure technical decisions are documented with clear tradeoffs * Facilitate planning exercises that surface unknowns and produce reliable estimates, accounting for tech debt and competing priorities * Author and mentor engineers on technical planning documents * Establish and model modern engineering practices including CI/CD, distributed tracing, DORA metrics, observability dashboards, and LLM\-assisted development * Get hands\-on when needed, prototyping or spiking to help the team communicate tradeoffs or unblock experimentation **What We Offer:** Entirely remote jobs that could be performed in Colorado: Employees can expect to be paid a salary of between $150,000 to $180,000\. Additional compensation may include a bonus or commission . Additional benefits include health care, vision, dental, retirement, Flexible Time Away, sick leave, and more. This salary range is merely an estimate and may vary based on an applicant's location, market data/ranges, an applicant's skills and prior relevant experience, certain degrees and certifications, and other relevant factors. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Outside Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected characteristics. Pursuant to applicable laws, we also make accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. We believe a diverse team is a strong team, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **About Plume:** Plume is a passion\-fueled, mission\-driven company that is trans\-founded with a vision to transform healthcare for every trans life. We hope to make gender\-affirming hormone therapy easily accessible at the touch of a button in every state of the US. This work is deeply personal and heart\-driven, and we want teammates who care about the mission and the people we serve. For the right candidates, we present a rare opportunity to do well by doing good. Plume offers an affirming, trans\-centered, culturally inclusive, and fun work environment filled with purpose.### **About the Role** As an Engineering Manager, you will play a crucial leadership role in guiding, mentoring, and growing a team of Software and Quality Assurance (QA) engineers while supporting the technical architecture and quality of our telehealth platform. You will work closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to ensure engineering and validation capacity is utilized to most effectively further departmental and organizational priorities. You will establish processes, quality strategies, and operational systems that ensure effective development, rigorous validation throughput, and reliable delivery of generated solutions. The right person for this role is comfortable spending half your time in a leadership role and half your time providing hands\-on individual technical contributions, working alongside your direct reports in feature implementation and bug resolution while stewarding a stable, consistent, and secure platform. ### **Responsibilities** **Leadership, Mentorship \& People Development** * **Lead engineering and QA talent:** Manage, mentor, and support the career progression of both software engineers and Quality Assurance (QA) engineers through regular 1:1s, continuous feedback, and structured performance evaluations. * **Cultivate an inclusive culture:** Foster a psychologically safe, collaborative, and empowering environment where team members feel celebrated and supported in their authentic identities. * **Lead hiring initiatives:** Serve as the hiring manager for software engineering and QA roles—defining interview stages, selecting interview panels, evaluating candidate feedback, and driving hiring decisions. **Quality Assurance, Metrics \& Platform Stability Strategy** * **Define quality strategy:** Establish a comprehensive, scalable QA strategy combining automated, manual, and regression testing to guarantee a reliable, consistent, and stable production platform. * **Monitor quality and validation throughput:** Track, analyze, and report on core quality metrics (e.g., defect escape rates, test pass/fail trends, mean time to **detect/resolve) and QA validation throughput to eliminate release bottlenecks.** * **Continuous QA process optimization:** Continuously refine testing pipelines, bug triage workflows, and validation criteria to increase velocity without compromising software safety or reliability. * **Maintain standards and compliance:** Ensure all software releases and testing protocols meet rigorous quality standards, data privacy mandates, and Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) compliance requirements. **Engineering Systems, Processes \& Delivery** * **Establish delivery systems:** Design, implement, and refine Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes and agile systems that ensure predictable, high\-velocity delivery of technical solutions. * **Optimize capacity allocation:** Manage and align engineering and QA bandwidth to maximize impact against departmental and organizational priorities. * **Drive progress visibility:** Establish clear tracking mechanisms, project milestones, and delivery dashboards so that development status, QA throughput, and blockers are transparent to all stakeholders. **Strategic Collaboration \& Modern Engineering Practices** * **Partner cross\-functionally:** Collaborate closely with Product, Clinical Operations, and Support teams to translate organizational goals into actionable engineering and quality backlogs. * **Enable organizational readiness:** Communicate technical concepts and release readiness clearly to non\-technical partners, ensuring smooth rollouts, adequate operational training, and seamless deployments. * **Navigate emerging tech, best practices \& AI evolution:** Stay abreast of industry trends, modern test automation frameworks, and evolving engineering methodologies. Proactively navigate the shifting development environment presented by Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities—providing thoughtful guidance that strictly aligns with company AI philosophy while being deeply informed by the perspectives, feedback, and working styles of your individual team members. **Hands\-On Technical Contribution \& Collaborative Architecture** * **Co\-develop solutions:** Actively write code, implement core features, and resolve complex bugs alongside your direct reports to maintain deep contextual understanding of the codebase. *  nd AI, with the ability to evaluate and integrate new tools in harmony with team consensus, engineering ethics, and organizational guidelines. * Proven track record of managing quality metrics and validation throughput (e.g., defect density, test automation coverage, release cycle duration) to drive platform reliability. * Demonstrated experience balancing direct technical contributions (feature development, debugging, bug fixes) with people management and process ownership. * Fluency in modern quality assurance and operational practices, including test automation frameworks, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) test suites, and observability/monitoring tools. * Clear, empathetic communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and non\-technical domains across clinical and operational stakeholders. * Strong empathy for and understanding of the transgender community, including the unique nuances and barriers encountered in gender\-affirming healthcare. ### **Nice\-To\-Have:** * Experience in telehealth, digital health, or HealthTech, with working familiarity with Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) regulations and Protected Health Information (PHI) safeguarding. * Experience implementing or scaling automated end\-to\-end testing frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Jest). * Background in fast\-paced startup or scale\-up environments, navigating rapid growth and evolving team structures. * Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, such as Terraform. **Applications for this role will be accepted until September 30th, 2026\.** **All Full\-Time Employees are Eligible for:*** Ground\-Floor Equity (Series B) * Free Medical, Dental, and Vision on the first of the month after you start full\-time work * Unlimited PTO * 11 paid holidays and company shut\-down for a week in December * 401(k) * Free Plume and BetterHelp Subscriptions Everyone associated with Plume gets the major benefit of having the best coworkers you could imagine if you love fiercely intelligent, heart\-forward, and mission\-driven collaborators. We use these tiers to maintain fair and competitive compensation across all locations. **Tier placement will be discussed during the offer stage.** Plume is an equal\-opportunity employer. Trans and gender\-nonconforming individuals are strongly encouraged to apply, particularly those who identify as People of Color. We positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of age, color, disability, national origin, ancestry, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable law. We will provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities upon request. Please let us know if you require any accommodations to apply or interview for this position. Only those legally authorized to work in the USA are eligible to apply; residency in the USA is a requirement of employment for this role. Join us today in shaping the future of healthtech and LGBTQ\+ care! **Please be aware that employment scams are on the rise.** Plume will only contact candidates using an official "@getplume.co" email address. jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** We are seeking a dynamic and highly skilled Network Engineer to join our innovative IT team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust network infrastructure solutions that support our organization’s operational needs. Your expertise will ensure seamless connectivity, optimal network performance, and top\-tier security across diverse environments, including data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise networks. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies and contribute to the resilience and scalability of our network systems. **Responsibilities** * Design, deploy, and manage complex network architectures encompassing LAN (Local Area Network), WAN (Wide Area Network), VPN (Virtual Private Network), and data center infrastructure. * Configure and support network hardware such as Cisco routers, switches, ASA firewalls, Meraki devices, Juniper equipment, and other networking equipment. * Implement and maintain security protocols including Cisco ISE (Identity Services Engine), PKI (Public Key Infrastructure), network access controls, and firewall configurations to safeguard organizational assets. * Monitor network performance using tools like SolarWinds, PRTG, and Splunk; troubleshoot issues related to equipment failures, connectivity disruptions, or security breaches. * Manage routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP, EIGRP; optimize network routing for high availability and load balancing across multiple sites. * Support VPN configuration and management for remote access solutions; ensure secure encrypted communications via IPsec or SSL protocols. * Conduct vulnerability assessments and implement security measures including IDS/IPS (Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems), encryption standards, and cloud security practices on platforms like AWS or Azure. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on system design projects involving virtualization (VMware vSphere), cloud integration, scripting (Python, Bash), and automation tools like Ansible. * Maintain comprehensive documentation of network configurations, procedures, and incident reports; adhere to ITIL best practices for service management. **Skills** * Extensive knowledge of computer networking principles including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SFTP/FTP protocols. * Proven experience with Cisco networking hardware such as routers, switches, ASA firewalls; familiarity with Meraki cloud\-managed devices. * Strong understanding of network security concepts including VPNs (VPN management \& configuration), encryption standards, SSO (Single Sign\-On), LDAP integration. * Proficiency in configuring routing protocols like OSPF, BGP; experience with MPLS networks for enterprise connectivity. * Skilled in system administration across various operating systems including Windows Server environments, Linux distributions (Ubuntu, CentOS, Debian), UNIX variants (Solaris/BSD). * Ability to troubleshoot equipment issues rapidly using diagnostic tools; perform network installation and upgrades efficiently. * Knowledge of virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere; experience with cloud services like AWS or Azure for hybrid infrastructure solutions. * Familiarity with scripting languages including Python or Shell Scripting for automation tasks; experience with DevOps practices is a plus. * Strong analytical skills for vulnerability assessment using tools like SolarWinds or Splunk; ability to implement high availability architectures ensuring minimal downtime. Join us to be part of a forward\-thinking team dedicated to building resilient networks that empower our organization’s growth! Pay: $74,230\.24 \- $89,395\.55 per year Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Quantum Model Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Do you enjoy making complex data systems understandable, trustworthy, and easy to operate? Are you energized by tracing how a model moves from source data and code through validation and deployment then building intuitive tools that make its state visible? **About PassiveLogic** PassiveLogic is the first fully autonomous platform for buildings. We've reinvented the fundamental principles of automation to democratize technology, optimize buildings, and reduce the world's carbon footprint. We are a team of technologists, engineers, and creatives dedicated to making a sustainable impact through real\-world solutions. We are looking for team members who have a passion for technology and want to work on cutting\-edge problems with real\-world solutions. Our culture is built on bringing together the most talented engineers, thinkers, and creatives \- backed by the world's leading investors \- working together to make the future a reality. **About the Role** This is a **career\-defining opportunity** to play a crucial role in a hyper\-scale AI company that is transforming the future of autonomous systems, energy, and the built environment. As a Quantum Model Platform Engineer, you will own the systems that turn PassiveLogic's Quantum models \- graph\-based digital representations of building equipment and systems \- into validated, published assets that teams can trust. You will develop the workflows that validate and promote models, build largely web\-based tools that explain what is deployed and where it has drifted, and investigate issues across model data, APIs, automation, and user interfaces. You will work across JavaScript, Python, and Swift. Prior Swift experience is not required. What matters is a strong software foundation, demonstrated success learning unfamiliar technologies, and the curiosity to understand a complex system by reading, running, and reasoning about its code. **What you'll do** **Own Quantum model validation and publishing:** Maintain and improve the workflows that validate models, manage their release state, and publish approved models reliably across environments. **Build tools that make deployed models understandable:** Create and evolve web applications, dashboards, reports, and visualizations that help teams inspect model libraries, compare environments, identify drift, and understand deployed building systems. **Develop automation across the toolchain:** Write and maintain JavaScript applications, Python scripts, and Swift command\-line tools that export, import, compare, audit, and reconcile model data. **Investigate behavior end to end:** Trace failures and unexpected results across source models, relational and graph\-shaped data, GraphQL and other APIs, asynchronous jobs, CI/CD pipelines, and browser interfaces until the underlying cause is understood. **Protect model quality and data integrity:** Design tests, validation checks, deployment safeguards, and clear operational reports that prevent invalid, untested, duplicated, or inconsistent models from reaching downstream teams. **Partner with model authors and platform teams:** Turn domain and engineering needs into practical tools, document how the systems work, communicate risks clearly, and leave workflows easier for the next person to understand and operate **What you'll bring** If your experience does not meet all our posted requirements below, we'd still love to hear from you. We are looking for practitioners who are passionate about understanding people and systems, committed to lifelong learning, and driven by the love of what they do. If that's you, please apply! **You must have** * **Proven software engineering experience:** A track record of delivering and maintaining software that other people rely on, including diagnosing failures and improving systems over time. * **Web application fundamentals:** Experience creating useful HTML interfaces with CSS and JavaScript, and connecting those interfaces to APIs or structured datasets. * **Scripting and automation experience:** Ability to use Python or a similar scripting language to transform data, automate repeatable work, and build maintainable operational tools. * **Relational data experience:** Practical experience working with relational databases, including schemas, queries, relationships, and data\-integrity concerns. * **Code\-centered systems thinking:** A strong desire to understand how a complex system actually works, with the ability to follow behavior through unfamiliar code, data, tests, logs, and service boundaries. * **Ability to learn new languages and frameworks:** You do not need prior Swift experience, but you must be able to show how you have become productive in an unfamiliar language, framework, or codebase. * **A thoughtful AI\-assisted development workflow:** Ability to demonstrate how you use AI tools to explore systems, plan and implement changes, and accelerate your work while verifying results through source inspection, tests, reviews, and sound engineering judgment. * **Ownership and communication:** Ability to work independently, explain technical findings clearly, ask precise questions, and collaborate with engineers and domain experts across teams. **You should have** * **Experience with software delivery workflows:** Familiarity with Git, code review, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, release processes, and maintaining production or internal developer tools. * **Experience with APIs and structured data:** Comfort working with technologies such as GraphQL, REST, WebSockets, JSON, and YAML, jobs.title: Senior Foundry Integration Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced **Senior Foundry Integration Engineer** to lead the development and maturation of our silicon photonic fabrication processes through close partnership with external commercial foundries. In this highly cross‑functional role, you will own integration strategy, accelerate learning through structured experimentation, and help drive our technologies from development into stable, ramped production. In this role, you will work at the intersection of device physics, materials, and manufacturing—coordinating across internal design, modeling, and systems teams while serving as a key technical interface to our external foundry partners. As a **Senior Foundry Integration Engineer** at Photonic you'll directly shape how quickly and reliably we learn, scale, and deliver. You will help establish development priorities, improve reproducibility, and enable scaling of Photonic’s quantum compute systems. **Please include a cover letter with your resume (in one file) describing how you would be a great fit at Photonic and what attributes you could bring to our growing team.** Application Deadline October 12, 2026 Department Nanofabrication Employment Type Full Time Location Remote (USA) Workplace type Fully remote Compensation $126,200 \- $173,500 / year **WHAT WE NEED YOU TO DO** -------------------------- * Own and execute process integration plans across external commercial foundries to mature and stabilize fabrication flows. * Define, organize, and drive experiments to accelerate learning and drive product performance. * Design experiments, analyze fabrication and measurement results, and synthesize data into clear technical conclusions. * Define next step process improvements and development priorities based on experimental outcomes. * Lead technical engagement with foundries, including aligning on integration intent, process assumptions, and learning objectives. * Translate system level and device level requirements into actionable fabrication strategies. * Collaborate closely with internal teams across nanofabrication, design, modeling, yield, and systems to produce chips supporting our core technology. * Ultimately drive successful production ramp of chips through improved yield, reproducibility, and process robustness. **WHAT YOU BRING TO OUR TEAM** ------------------------------ * Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a closely related field. * 3\+ years of industry experience in process integration, semiconductor fabrication, or related roles. * Hands‑on experience working in or with a commercial semiconductor foundry. * Strong understanding of semiconductor process integration, unit processes, and cross‑module interactions in both foundry and university cleanrooms. * Experience and intuition in silicon photonics fabrication and design. * Demonstrated ability to design experiments, analyze data, and drive data‑informed technical decisions. * Excellent communication skills and comfort working across organizational and company boundaries. **An exceptional candidate will bring:*** Experience supporting semiconductor technologies through development into production ramp. * Familiarity with advanced photonic, electronic, or heterogeneous integration platforms. * Prior experience serving as a technical interface between internal R\&D teams and external manufacturing partners. * Track record of accelerating learning cycles in complex fabrication environments. **WHY YOU SHOULD WORK WITH US** ------------------------------- * Work closely with some of the brightest innovators in quantum technologies to drive breakthroughs that redefine computing * Enjoy a fast\-paced and fun environment where you can try new things while solving innovative challenges every day * Inclusive company culture that values collaboration * Regular social events and fun activities keep our global team connected * Competitive compensation package including base salary, stock options, and relocation assistance for global talent * Comprehensive benefits including extended health, dental, life, long term disability, an employee assistance program, parental leave top\-ups, and a flexible spending account *The description above is what we think an ideal candidate would look like for this role. At Photonic, we understand that everyone has a different work and life journey. If you feel your experience is close to what we've described, but you might not meet all the requirements, please still apply! All roles listed are for current vacancies. While artificial intelligence (AI) tools may be used to assist in reviewing applicant profiles, they do not determine candidate outcomes. Our hiring decisions are made by people, not algorithms. We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of equity, diversity, and inclusion. We embrace and encourage our employees’ differences, knowing that these very differences inspire innovation and build better teams. If there are any accommodations our team can make throughout our hiring process, please let us know.* **About Photonic** ------------------ Photonic Inc. is a leading quantum technology company developing commercial\-scale quantum computers and quantum networks to address some of the world’s most pressing challenges in materials science, drug discovery, climate change, and security. The company’s approach unlocks performance at scale through unmatched distributed quantum computing capabilities. Photonic’s high\-connectivity Entanglement First™ architecture leverages a unique qubit modality—optically linked silicon spin qubits—to enable powerful computation, efficient error correction, and seamless integration with existing data center and telecom environments. Headquartered in Vancouver, British Columbia, with operations in the United States and United Kingdom, Photonic’s team is advancing quantum technologies alongside leading investors, partners, and customers worldwide.

jobs.description: **About Us** At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive "sick\-care" to proactive health care. Our award\-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non\-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient\-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against "we caught it too late again". The Senior QA Engineer II will lead quality efforts for products supporting healthcare providers, patient workflows, and diagnostic reporting. This role combines hands\-on testing with technical leadership, cross\-functional collaboration, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate is self\-directed, organized, and committed to delivering reliable, accessible, and user\-centered products. **This role is fully remote; however, we have a preference for candidates able to work in the Pacific Time Zone (PST) hours to better align with team collaboration.** **This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).** Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting\-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise \- join us to make a difference in people's lives! **What You'll Do** * Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to establish quality throughout the product development lifecycle. * Analyze business requirements, architecture, interfaces, integrations, and dependencies to develop comprehensive, risk\-based test strategies. * Define and improve quality standards, testing practices, and processes across the team and partner teams. * Create and maintain test strategies, plans, cases, and supporting documentation. * Perform manual and automated testing of web and mobile applications, including exploratory, functional, acceptance, regression, end\-to\-end, and UI testing. * Define and advance test automation standards and coverage, balancing product risk with reliability, maintainability, and execution speed. * Test REST APIs and backend services for correctness, reliability, and resilience. * Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects and quality risks through resolution. * Lead root cause analysis with engineers to resolve defects and prevent recurrence. * Communicate test strategy, quality risks, release readiness, and tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Identify systemic quality and process issues, align the appropriate stakeholders, and drive practical improvements through completion. * Mentor engineers and other team members to strengthen quality practices and shared ownership of quality. * Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to improve release confidence and delivery speed. * Evaluate web and mobile applications against applicable accessibility requirements, including WCAG, through manual and automated testing. * Contribute to performance and security testing based on product risk and team needs. **What You'll Bring** * 7\+ years of professional software quality assurance experience. * Demonstrated success leading quality initiatives across cross\-functional and partner teams. * Deep knowledge of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and risk\-based testing for complex systems. * Strong understanding of web and mobile technologies, client\-server architecture, APIs, integrations, and system dependencies. * Hands\-on experience testing native or cross\-platform mobile applications on iOS and Android, including testing across devices, operating\-system versions, screen sizes, and network conditions. * Hands\-on experience testing REST APIs and backend services. * Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java. * Experience developing or improving test automation frameworks, standards, coverage, reliability, and maintainability. * Experience using modern web or mobile automation frameworks and integrating automated tests into CI/CD workflows. * Knowledge of accessibility testing and standards such as WCAG, with experience using tools such as Axe, Lighthouse, or screen readers. * Experience with defect tracking and test\-management tools, such as Jira, in an Agile development environment. * Strong analytical and communication skills, including the ability to explain quality risks and technical tradeoffs to varied audiences. * A record of driving cross\-functional quality or process improvements through completion. * Experience mentoring technical and non\-technical colleagues and building quality capability across teams. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. **Our Values** First: we are **Pioneers** * Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding. Second: we are **Platform\-Builders** * We're always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what's ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission. Above all: we are **Patients** * We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients' lives, and we won't stop till everyone can benefit from our work. **What We Offer** * An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health * We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team \- Prenuvo provides free, whole\-body scans to each team member * Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we're doing big things with bright minds \- there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way * Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do \- our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize * Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing \- we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it * Retirement made easy! Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre\-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions. * We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family * **The base salary for this role ranges from** **$165,000\-$185,000** **in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location** *We are an equal\-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* *As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.* **Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain \[****prenuvo.com****]. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third\-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to jobs@prenuvo.com.**

jobs.description: **Company Description** Press Ganey is the leading experience measurement, data analytics, and insights provider for complex industries—a status we earned over decades of deep partnership with clients to help them understand and meet the needs of their key stakeholders. Our earliest roots are in U.S. healthcare –perhaps the most complex of all industries. Today we serve clients around the globe in every industry to help them improve the Human Experiences at the heart of their business. We serve our clients through an unparalleled offering that combines technology, data, and expertise to enable them to pinpoint and prioritize opportunities, accelerate improvement efforts and build lifetime loyalty among their customers and employees. Like all great companies, our success is a function of our people and our culture. Our employees have world\-class talent, a collaborative work ethic, and a passion for the work that have earned us trusted advisor status among the world’s most recognized brands. As a member of the team, you will help us create value for our clients, you will make us better through your contribution to the work and your voice in the process. Ours is a path of learning and continuous improvement; team efforts chart the course for corporate success. **Our Mission:** We empower organizations to deliver the best experiences. With industry expertise and technology, we turn data into insights that drive innovation and action. **Our Values:** To put Human Experience at the heart of organizations so every person can be seen and understood. * **Energize the customer relationship:** Our clients are our partners. We each play our part and empower our teammates to do the same. * **Commit to learning:** Every win is a springboard. Every hurdle is a lesson. We use each experience as an opportunity to grow. * **Dare to innovate:** We challenge the status quo with creativity and innovation as our true north. * **Better together:** We check our egos at the door. We're hiring an ML Engineer II to help expand and scale our Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence capabilities. As an ML Engineer II, you should love building simple solutions to solve hard customer problems, crafting reliable code in an agile environment, and taking ownership of software quality from end to end. expertise alongside senior team members. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build, test, and deploy production\-ready AI agents and agentic workflows that integrate seamlessly with enterprise applications and business processes. * Implement robust evaluation, monitoring, guardrail, and safety frameworks defined by senior team members to de\-risk LLM\-powered applications. * Develop and maintain AI\-enabled features within our existing Java/Spring platform and distributed microservices ecosystem. * Collaborate with AI Scientists and ML Engineers to productionize models and translate experimentation into reliable software. * Staying up to date with emerging AI technologies and recommending pragmatic adoption strategies that improve product capabilities and developer productivity. * Work closely with, and incorporate feedback from other specialists, tech\-ops, and product managers * Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, and requirement planning to continuously grow technical skills and domain knowledge. * Attend daily stand\-up meetings, collaborate with your peers, prioritize features, and work with a sense of urgency to deliver value to your customers * Finding quick ways to prototype and test possible solutions to large problems **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. * 2–5 years of hands\-on experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, with a proven track record of designing, building, and optimizing ML models using frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow for production environments. * Solid Comp velopment using modern programming languages such as Python, Java, or C\#. * Hands\-on experience developing, testing, and supporting applied machine learning services within enterprise software ecosystems. * Practical experience building and maintaining software components for AI\-enabled applications or distributed systems. * Hands\-on experience integrating AI capabilities into existing enterprise applications rather than building standalone AI prototypes. * Experience implementing and deploying production\-grade LLM applications using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Spring AI, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or similar technologies. * Solid working knowledge of Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool calling, prompt engineering, and core AI agent principles. * Experience in observability, CI/CD, automated testing, and production operations for AI applications. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with Databricks, vector search technologies, embedding models, conversational AI, and evaluation strategies for AI agents. * Experience working with AI developer tooling and platform capabilities that accelerate feature delivery. * Experience building large\-scale Java microservices using Spring Boot. * Experience with cloud\-native platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), Kubernetes, and containerized deployments. * Familiarity with model serving, inference optimization, caching strategies, and cost optimization for enterprise AI systems **Don’t meet every single requirement?** Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet At Press Ganey we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **Additional Information for US based jobs:** Press Ganey Associates LLC is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and well committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and basis of disability or any other federal, state, or local protected class. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information. The expected base salary for this position ranges from $110,000 to $130,000\. It is not typical for offers to be made at or near the top of the range. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, licensure or certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to base salary and a competitive benefits package, successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus or commission tied to achieved results. jobs.title: Controls Engineer II
jobs.description: As an Automation Specialist II you will be responsible for the design of control system details, instrumentation configuration, preparation for implementation, implementation, testing, documentation, and training. **A Typical Day at Prime Controls*** Collaborates with project managers and estimators to assess potential projects and submit proposals. * Reads and interprets diagrams and documentation and communicates with customers to understand objectives and preferences. * Develops the overall architecture and communication strategy between control system elements. * Works with the customer and other stakeholders to define and document control system functionality. * Develops BOMs, IO lists, and requirements for control panels * Serves as the technical lead for small projects. This includes building PLC and HMI templates for the project. * Develops PLC programs in Ladder, Function Block, and other languages. * Develops the human machine interface (HMI). * Develops hardware and software test plans and writes simulation logic for the testing of the PLC and HMI system. * Develops a training plan and materials to train operations and maintenance personnel. * Communicates and coordinates with management of the installation team to ensure that technicians are executing per documented processes. * Tests the installed system to observe system functionality and ensure that the programs function as designed. * Troubleshoots problems that occur during startup that are caused by incorrect drawings, changes in customer desires, inaccurate instrumentation specifications, or other technical issues. Diagnoses and resolves software and hardware interface issues. * Trains customers on use and operation of client\-specific system integration software. * Interfaces with manufacturers and vendors of software and application products, especially with regard to problem diagnosis and resolution. * Works with others to address design problems as necessary. * May respond to service calls to troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair programming and system failures. * Mentor and train less experienced employees. **What You Will Bring** ***The Basic**** 4 years Industrial Controls experience in architectural, engineering or construction (AEC) industry or similar field * Bachelor of Science Degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, related Bachelor’s discipline, related degree from a Technical College or equivalent Industrial controls experience * 4 years of experience in PLC programming * Proficiency with Allen Bradley equipment and systems * Proficiency in PLC Programming including ladder logic, function block, and structured text * Familiarity with networking (Ethernet/IP) * Experience and knowledge of HMIs ***The Preferred**** 6 years of experience in architectural, engineering or construction (AEC) industry or similar field * Proficiency with AutoCAD – Autodesk software

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description: Prysmian is the world leader in the energy and telecom cable systems industry. Each year, the company manufactures thousands of miles of underground and submarine cables and systems for power transmission and distribution, as well as medium low voltage cables for the construction and infrastructure sectors. We also produce a comprehensive range of optical fibers, copper cables and connectivity for voice, video, and data transmission for the telecommunication sector. We are 30,000 employees, across 50\+ countries. Everyone at Prysmian has the potential to make their mark; because whatever you do, wherever you are based, you will be part of a company that is helping transform the world around us. **Why You’ll Love This Role** As a Process Engineer, you’ll be at the center of a fast‑paced, high‑tech manufacturing environment where your work directly influences product quality, efficiency, and throughput. This is a **hands‑on, boots‑on‑the‑ground engineering role —** perfect for someone who enjoys being out on the production floor, solving real problems in real time, and working closely with operators, technicians, and multiple departments to keep products moving through the process smoothly and on schedule. You’ll gain meaningful experience with advanced fiber‑optic cable production, collaborate with experienced engineers and cross‑functional teams, and take ownership of projects that require attention, follow‑through, and initiative. For an early‑career engineer who wants to learn quickly, build practical manufacturing expertise, and grow into larger responsibilities, this role offers an exceptional opportunity. **What You’ll Be Doing:*** Investigating manufacturing trends and helping solve real production challenges. * Spending time on the production floor to ensure products move through each stage efficiently. * Supporting process improvements that increase efficiency, stability, and product quality. * Working with production teams to optimize equipment performance and resolve issues. * Participating in new product trials and process enhancements. * Assisting with troubleshooting, machine setups, and equipment upgrades. * Analyzing production data to identify opportunities for improvement. * Collaborating cross‑functionally with Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and Production teams. * Helping create training materials, SOPs, and technical documentation. * Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, 6S, and root‑cause analysis. * Taking ownership of ongoing projects that require consistent attention and proactive problem‑solving. **What We’re Looking For:*** Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field preferred). * 0–3 years of manufacturing experience. * Strong analytical thinking and problem‑solving skills. * A collaborative mindset and eagerness to learn. * Comfort working directly on the production floor and engaging with multiple departments. * Ability to thrive in a fast‑moving manufacturing environment. * Experience with fiber optics, wire \& cable manufacturing, ERP systems, Excel, or Minitab is a plus — not required. **Build Your Future With Us!** At Prysmian, your ideas matter. Your growth matters. And the work you do helps connect the world in meaningful, lasting ways. If you’re ready to build your engineering career with a global industry leader and you enjoy being hands‑on, collaborative, and close to the process, we’d be excited to meet you.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Qualitate** ------------------- Qualitate is building the AI\-native continuous intelligence platform for enterprises, investment firms, and asset managers. We automate the entire primary research workflow, from study design and expert recruitment through AI\-moderated interviews and insight synthesis, replacing weeks of manual research with high output signal in hours. Primary research remains slow and transactional for everyone involved. Investment and corporate strategy teams spend hundreds of hours coordinating intermediaries, scheduling calls, and synthesizing fragmented insights. Experts face repetitive outreach, screener calls, schedule wrangling, and one\-off engagements that offer them little control or lasting value. Qualitate transforms this experience with an AI\-native expert network platform that gives participants the flexibility to contribute on their own time while enabling research at unprecedented scale. Qualitate’s AI Moderator conducts thousands of conversations with experts each month, capturing forward\-looking purchasing plans, competitive displacement, and real\-time ROI signals. Our continuous intelligence platform then turns these conversations into quantified, time\-series outputs tracking over 10,000 public and private companies, queryable instantly in natural language. Our customers include some of the world's largest enterprises, hedge funds, PE firms, credit investors, and venture capital firms. **The Role** ------------ Qualitate is building the primary research layer for investors and corporate strategy teams. Our AI interviews experts, turns those conversations into structured intelligence, and delivers it to the funds and companies acting on it. Next, we're turning that into an always\-on intelligence platform. Customers will bring their own proprietary data alongside ours, and AI agents will run research workflows end to end. All of that runs on data, and as our first dedicated **Data Engineer**, you'll own it. You'll build the pipelines that feed our AI moderator, the models that turn thousands of expert conversations into structured, searchable insights, and the systems that will let customers plug their own data into Qualitate. You'll work closely with Applied AI, Market Research, and Engineering, but the architecture decisions are yours. Our clients make investment decisions on this data, so accuracy isn't a feature. It's the product. You'll set that bar and shape how data works at Qualitate for years to come. **What You’ll Own** ------------------- * **Build and maintain data pipelines**. Design ETL/ELT processes that ingest unstructured data, quantitative metrics, 3rd party datasets into our core systems. * **Design data models and data systems.** Build and evolve data models across relational and non\-relational systems. You'll work with structured application data in relational databases alongside unstructured data stored in S3 and indexed in semantic search engines. * **Build AI\-powered data enrichment pipelines.** Use LLMs and other AI systems to extract structured information from unstructured data, classify and enrich records, and integrate AI\-generated outputs into reliable production data workflows and evaluation systems. * **Own data quality end\-to\-end.** Build automated QA checks, monitoring, and alerting to catch anomalies before they become client\-facing problems. * **Partner cross\-functionally.** Work directly with Research, Applied AI, and Engineering to define schemas, data contracts, and reporting needs as new features are shipped. * **Document as you build**. Maintain clear data lineage, schema documentation, and runbooks — you're building the systems, so you're setting the data foundation of the company. **Who This Role Is For** ------------------------ * **You're strong in SQL.** You can write complex, performant queries against relational datasets and understand how to reason about data at scale. * **You're a capable software engineer.** You have experience with either **TypeScript** or **Python** and can write production\-quality code for automation, data pipelines, integrations, and internal tooling. * **You can build robust data integrations.** You can work with APIs, databases, files, and other external data sources and build reliable ingestion processes around authentication, pagination, rate limits, incremental extraction, retries, schema changes, and error handling. * **Research and integrate third\-party datasets.** Research and evaluate company identifiers, entity\-matching strategies, corporate hierarchies, subsidiaries, acquisitions, and build reliable processes to map and reconcile these entities across different data sources. * **You can work across different types of data.** You're comfortable with structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data and understand the tradeoffs between relational databases, object storage, search/indexing systems, and analytical data stores. * **You'll work with our current stack and help shape what comes next.** You will help maintain our TypeScript pipelines running on scheduled jobs and Postgres\-native queues, S3 for object storage, and AWS Bedrock for retrieval. Experience with a modern warehouse and transformation stack (e.g. Snowflake/BigQuery, dbt, Airflow) is a plus. * **You're comfortable with ambiguity.** Early\-stage data infrastructure is messy — you're energized by building order out of that, not frustrated by it. **What Sets You Apart** ----------------------- * Prior experience in data engineering for a technology startup, ideally in fintech * You've been early on the engineering team at a company and helped build the function from scratch — not just used tools others built. * Exposure to LLM\-driven data pipelines (labeling, moderation, quality scoring) is a strong plus. * You've worked in market research, expert networks, or financial services and understand the data integrity bar those industries demand. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- * **Base salary:** $170\-200K depending on experience. * **Bonus:** Eligible for cash bonus tied to individual and company performance * **Equity:** Meaningful early\-stage grant with upside tied to company growth. * **Benefits:** Health coverage, flexible PTO, paid holidays. * **Location:** Full\-time, in\-person in New York City. **What to Expect Working at Qualitate** --------------------------------------- * **Excellence.** You'll be held accountable to an exceptionally high bar for quality and impact. * **High velocity.** Fast\-paced work environment in terms of growth, decision making, and time to impact. * **High agency.** Ownership over how you work, not just what you work on. We hire people we trust to figure it out. * **Shared ambition.** A small, early team disrupting the multi\-billion dollar market research industry with AI. * **Joy.** We work hard and genuinely enjoy working with each other. Dedication to our work is matched only by our passion for fostering an enjoyable, collaborative work environment.

jobs.title: Solution Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Who You Are** You are dedicated to discovering the needs of your customers and matching them with the right product solutions. You care deeply about technology, but just as strongly about the workflow and processes that bring it to life. You can present technical concepts to stakeholders at all levels, adjusting to your approach to the audience at hand. You possess a high attention to detail but know how to strategize and map a path to long\-term success. You are a pragmatic self\-starter who is results focused and knows how to prioritize. You are looking for an opportunity to learn and grow in a fast\-paced environment where you will define new processes, inform next\-generation products, and help drive the growth of an organization. You feel strongly about being mission driven in your work. Above all else, you are innately curious and motivated to learn new things. ### **Who We Are** Quantifind is *the* Risk Intelligence company. We help some of the world's biggest banks identify money laundering and fraud. Quantifind also works with government agencies, using the same platform, to uncover criminal networks and support national security. Quantifind delivers results through an AI\-driven software\-as\-a\-service (SaaS) solution with consumer\-grade user experiences. Quantifind's Graphyte platform uncovers signals of risk across disparate and unstructured text sources using artificial intelligence and natural language processing techniques. In financial crimes risk management, Quantifind's solution uniquely combines internal financial institution data with public domain data to assess risk in the context of Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Fraud Risk Management, and Anti\-Money Laundering (AML) processes. Today these compliance processes are burdened by ever\-increasing regulatory responsibilities and an expectation of frictionless transactions. Legacy technologies demand increasingly more human resources as the operations expand; Quantifind's solution offers a way to cut through the inefficiency and enhance effectiveness simultaneously. Demand for this solution is fueling our rapid growth. To help you succeed, we provide a supportive environment that fosters collaboration between teams and team members, where learning and professional growth are considered a key part of your success, and of ours. We offer a flexible work environment with a family friendly work\-life balance. ### **What a Great Candidate Looks Like:** * You have 3\+ years of experience in a customer\-facing technical support, analytical, or consulting role * You have a high EQ and impeccable communication skills * You hold a BS or MS in computer science, mathematics, or engineering or have equivalent technical professional experience * You have specific experience in the delivery or implementation of SaaS software within large enterprise environments * You are experienced in interacting directly with Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and are familiar with common API protocols * You have experience working with relational databases and SQL commands * You are conversant in the agile software development process and relevant tools such as Atlassian Jira® and GitHub * You are familiar with common data formats such as csv and JSON, as well as the methods and tools for reading, writing, manipulating, and secure transfer of such data files * You are consultative and collaborative in your approach to problem solving * You are eager to evolve and face new challenges ### **The Opportunity We Offer** You will be responsible for designing and supporting implementations of the Graphyte product suite both pre\- and post\-sale, ensuring frictionless solutions that drive success. Your clients will include some of the largest financial institutions in the world, and you will be the one of the first to witness the outsize impact of our software on enterprise operational efficiency. On a daily basis you will interact with Quantifind's Customer Success Managers, Technical Project Managers, and Technical Product Managers, as well as our clients' IT and business stakeholders. You will manage complex technical projects, triage inbound questions and requests, help manage technical documentation, and operate as a key conduit of communication. You will have every opportunity to operate as an extension of the Product development team, gathering evidence and feedback from the field and being the first to bring Quantifind's innovative product solutions to life. Quantifind operates an informal hybrid schedule around hubs in Palo Alto, California, Washington D.C., New York City, New York and Boston, Massachusetts with the balance of engineers in the Palo Alto area. Quantifind is currently using a hybrid mix of working from home and in the office, with regular in\-person touchpoints and shared office space. Due to the location of our clients our preference is an East Coast based candidate, with New York City, New York preferred. #### **A highlight of our benefits:** * Competitive salary * Company Equity * Exceptional benefits package * Flexible Vacation \& Paid Time Off * Employer\-matched 401(k) plan * A fun environment where work\-life balance is valued The base salary range for this full\-time position is $130,000 to $165,000\. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location, and the range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations.
