jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description: At REGENT, we’re on a mission to revolutionize regional transportation between coastal cities. We're not just building vehicles, we're creating a new category of transportation: the Seaglider. These groundbreaking wing\-in\-ground\-effect craft travel just above the water’s surface, combining the speed of an airplane with the low operating costs of a boat. Capable of 180 miles at 180 mph on today's battery tech (and up to 400 miles with next\-gen batteries), Seagliders will unlock fast, affordable, and sustainable coastal transit for passengers and cargo \- connecting cities, islands, and communities like never before. Backed by leading investors and powered by a team of passionate, forward\-thinking engineers, builders, and operators, we’re now scaling from a breakthrough prototype to full production \- and building the team to make it happen. **Role Overview** ================= As a **Mechanical Design Engineer** at REGENT, you'll design, refine, and mature the mechanical systems that make our Seagliders work — spanning structures, mechanisms, actuation, fluid handling, and vehicle\-level integration. This is a hands\-on design role on our Hardware Engineering team, and it exists because we're scaling from a prototype environment toward full\-rate production and need dedicated design capacity to improve, troubleshoot, and harden the wide variety of mechanical systems across our platforms. You'll own mechanical design work across Squire, Paladin, and Viceroy — taking subsystems and mechanisms from concept through CAD, analysis, prototype, and test. You'll size fasteners and joints, run the hand calculations and analyses that justify a design, build and test prototypes in the lab, and work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with our electrical, software, and program management teams to close integration challenges. Over time, you'll become a technical focal point for one or more areas of ownership. Success in this role looks like becoming a trusted, go\-to contributor: independently progressing designs, identifying real issues rather than just executing tasks, and helping mature key REGENT technologies like hydrofoil retraction and control surface actuation toward production. Within a year, you'll be shaping mechanical system architectures and making sound engineering decisions with limited oversight. If you're energized by owning real mechanical hardware end\-to\-end — designing it, analyzing it, building it, and watching it fly — and you want to do that work at the intersection of cutting\-edge innovation and real\-world impact, we'd love to have you on the team. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Design mechanical hardware across a range of systems** — structures, mechanisms, actuation, thermal, fluid, and electromechanical — from concept through production\-intent CAD and documentation. * **Justify your designs with analysis** — hand calculations plus structural (FEA), kinematic (range of motion, power, torque), thermal, or fluid analysis as the system demands, including fastener sizing and tolerance stack\-ups. * **Build and test prototypes in the lab** — validate concepts hands\-on with limited supervision, and design or improve the test rigs, benches, and fixtures that let the team iterate quickly on real data. * **Re\-envision and mature existing designs** — improve mechanical systems already deployed on REGENT products, strengthening reliability, weight, and manufacturability for production. * **Partner across disciplines** — interface directly with electrical, software, and controls teams to solve integration challenges, and work with program management to keep projects on schedule. * **Own projects end\-to\-end** — serve as the responsible engineer for assigned design investigations from kickoff to completion, progressing multiple concepts in parallel while tracking their trade\-offs. * **Advance key REGENT technologies** — contribute to core systems like hydrofoil retraction and control surface actuation, helping move them from prototype toward full\-rate production. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * **Demonstrated mechanical design experience** across a variety of system types — structures, mechanisms, actuation, thermal, fluid, or electromechanical. * **Strong command of machine elements and mechanisms** — bearings, locks, latches, hinges, linkages, seals, pulleys, sliders — ideally having designed systems using several of them. * **Familiarity with drive and power transmission** — motors, gearboxes, gear trains, belt and chain drives, and hydraulics — plus experience selecting fastening and joining schemes and sizing joints. * **Advanced CAD proficiency** designing complex components and large assemblies (NX preferred, not required), with clean, well\-organized models others can build on. * **A solid analysis foundation** — comfortable using hand calcs and FEA to justify design choices, with sound judgment about which analysis a system actually needs. * **Practical manufacturing knowledge** — machining, sheet metal, composites, welding, castings, and additive — and how each shapes design decisions, alongside materials selection and the failure modes (fatigue, corrosion, wear, buckling) that drive it. * **Bonus: structural analysis depth** — experience with FEMAP or ANSYS. * **Bonus: eVTOL or flight\-hardware background** — designing flight\-worthy, human\-carrying assets, and breadth across multiple mechanical disciplines rather than depth in a single specialty. **Who We're Looking For** ------------------------- * **Collaborative Team Player:** You believe that great things happen when teams work together. You communicate effectively and collaborate with engineers, stakeholders, and other cross\-functional teams to align on goals and move projects forward. You bring people together, ensuring that everyone is on the same page and moving towards a shared vision. * **Creative Problem Solver**: You thrive on tackling complex challenges and finding innovative solutions. You don't just patch issues \- you improve processes, anticipate downstream impacts, and help turn one\-off fixes into scalable solutions that raise the bar for future builds. * **Adaptable \& Agile:** In a fast\-paced, ever\-evolving startup environment, you quickly adapt to changing priorities and requirements. You approach challenges with a calm, resilient mindset, and know how to pivot and adjust your approach as needed, ensuring that progress continues without missing a beat. * **Innovative Mindset**: You’re driven by curiosity and a passion for technology. You’re passionate about driving continuous improvement, embracing new technologies and methodologies to enhance efficiency, quality, and team performance. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Competitive compensation** including a robust equity incentive plan. * Comprehensive **health, dental, and vision insurance \-** we cover **100%** of your premiums. * **401(k)** with company matching, so you can plan for the future. * Generous **flexible time off**, paid parental leave, and company\-wide holiday breaks. * **Relocation packages** available for those moving to join our team. * Daily, **free catered lunches** * Learning \& professional development opportunities **If you’re ready to take on an exciting challenge, grow with us, and make a lasting impact, we want to hear from you.** Even if you don’t meet every requirement, but you see yourself contributing to our mission, we encourage you to apply! We value diverse skillsets and experiences and believe in the potential of passionate individuals to make a big impact. **Equal Opportunity Employer** REGENT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Asbestos Training & Compliance Coordinator - Oak Ridge, TN
jobs.description: Company Overview RSI provides full\-service environmental and nuclear solutions supporting clients through all phases of cleanup, nuclear operations and security, and facility lifecycle management. Built on a strong foundation of collaboration and a people\-first culture, RSI delivers safe, technically sound solutions that help clients achieve mission success in some of the nation's most complex environments. RSI is part of the ASRC Industrial Services family of companies unified by purpose to deliver safe, reliable solutions to our clients’ unique challenges. We are committed to providing technically superior service, adding value at every stage, and leaving things better than we found them. **Job Summary:** The Asbestos Training \& Compliance Coordinator is responsible for leading, coordinating, and maintaining safety compliance, training, and certification programs with a primary focus on asbestos hazards and state\-mandated regulatory accreditations. Serving within a Department of Energy (DOE) prime contractor environment, this role manages state\-level asbestos accreditations and training profiles for over 600 employees across multiple nuclear and high\-hazard operational areas (including Y\-12, ORNL, and specialized waste facilities). The coordinator acts as the primary instructional lead for asbestos awareness, manages complex compliance databases, coordinates regulatory financial transactions with state entities, and supports secondary safety programs such as Beryllium protection, fire safety, and emergency response. Roles \& Responsibilities 1\. Instructional Leadership \& Training Delivery * Lead Instruction: Serve as the lead instructor for Asbestos Awareness courses, ensuring training content is engaging, updated, and meets all regulatory criteria. * Backup Instruction: Maintain qualifications to act as a secondary/backup instructor for other safety courses, including Adult First Aid/CPR/AED, Fire Watch, and Fire Extinguisher Practical operations. * Continuous Qualification: Proactively pursue cross\-qualification in emerging site programs, such as the Suspect and Counterfeit Items (S\&CI) training curriculum. 2\. Regulatory Compliance \& Accreditation Management * Accreditation Management: Oversee and maintain state asbestos accreditations for over 600 personnel across seven distinct operational areas (including Y\-12, ORNL, Heritage, NucOps, EMWMF, ORRLF, and TWPC) to prevent regulatory lapses. * Regulatory Surveillance: Regularly review and evaluate state laws, EPA regulations, and Tennessee Department of Environment and Conservation (TDEC) guidelines to ensure organizational compliance. * Financial Facilitation: Coordinate directly with Control Account Managers (CAMs) and Project Control Engineers (PCEs) to process, track, and approve fee payments to state bodies (e.g., TDEC, META) for accreditation processing. 3\. Training Administration \& Database Management * LMS Administration: Utilize specialized Learning Management Systems (such as LEARN) and reporting tools to track qualification cycles, monitor training records, and issue proactive notifications regarding mandatory credentials. * Access \& Qualification Cards: Administer and issue official qualification and field access cards to authorized personnel (e.g., Forklift, PAPR, Beryllium, Radiological Worker, and general access). * Continuous Improvement: Evaluate and categorize incoming Opportunity for Improvement (OFI) safety and operational procedures utilizing the Corrective Action Management System (CAMS). 4\. Operations \& Vendor Coordination * Supervisory Liaison: Work directly with field superintendents and department supervisors to manage individual and group asbestos accreditations, scheduling, and training conflicts. * Vendor Coordination: Manage end\-to\-end schedules and logistics with external vendors to facilitate outsourced workforce certifications and mandatory re\-certifications. * Cross\-Program Support: Provide alternate program leadership and technical support for adjacent safety programs, such as the site Beryllium Program, ensuring proper integration with medical surveillance approvals. **Requirements and Education:** * Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited institution. A degree with emphasis in Education, Communications, Occupational Health \& Safety, or a related field is preferred. * Safety Coordination / Training Admin: Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in training coordination, safety\-related instruction, or regulatory administrative support. * High\-Hazard Industry Exposure: At least 1 year of hands\-on experience in a radiological, nuclear, or industrial hazardous waste remediation environment (such as asbestos abatement or radiological waste handling). * Regulatory Liaison: Demonstrated experience working with external regulatory bodies and managing state\-level accreditation files. **Required Certifications (or ability to obtain upon hire):** * Asbestos Worker / Asbestos Abatement Certification * Hazwoper (Hazardous Waste Operations and Emergency Response) * Radiological Worker II (Rad Worker II) * Adult First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor or Trainer Certification * Beryllium Worker Certification **Preferred Requirements and Education:** * Instructional Delivery: Strong classroom management, presentation, and facilitation skills tailored to both technical field workers and management personnel. * Software Proficiency: Mastery of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and intermediate knowledge of enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS) and tracking tools. * Process \& Record Organization: Exceptional attention to detail in document control, financial tracking, and maintaining auditable personnel safety records. * Problem Solving \& Troubleshooting: Ability to analyze state laws, operational guidelines, and procedural changes to recommend strategic training alignment. Clearance and Health Regiments * Criminal Background Check * Pre\-placement Drug Screening This position requires a REAL ID\-compliant driver's license or identification card; or a U.S. passport as long as it clearly displays issuance date, expiration date, and color photo image. This is a mandatory requirement necessary for access to company facilities and/or for travel purposes. REAL ID\-compliant driver’s licenses are identifiable by a gold star in the upper right corner. EEO Statement RSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, gender, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identification, national origin, religion, marital status, ancestry, citizenship, disability, protected veteran status, or any other factor prohibited by applicable law

relational databases, specifically Oracle Database, including strong proficiency in PL/SQL, query optimization, and schema management. * Web Development: Proven experience with core web technologies including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and modern development frameworks/libraries. * Tooling: Proficiency with development tools such as Git/Version Control, Visual Studio Code, and Oracle database tools (e.g., Toad for Oracle). **Preferred Requirements and Education:** * LMS \& Training Systems: Direct experience administering or developing for Learning Management Systems (LMS) and deploying SCORM\-compliant training packages. * E\-Learning Authoring: Familiarity with e\-learning authoring tools such as iSpring or Articulate Storyline. * Cloud Solutions: Experience or exposure to Oracle Fusion Cloud Learning (OLC) or other enterprise cloud\-based ERP modules. * Multi\-Language Competency: Exposure to multiple programming paradigms (e.g., Java, Python, C\#, or PHP). * Minimum Requirement: Associate of Applied Science (A.A.S.) or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related business/technical field. * jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
jobs.description: **Description** Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. Senior Full Stack Software Engineer — News \& Insights We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join the News \& Insights team. The team builds the platform behind Realtor.com’s high\-traffic news experience, serving millions of readers and distributing content to major publishing partners. This is a backend\-heavy full\-stack role for an engineer who can own server\-side systems while contributing to frontend features. You will work across APIs, data integrations, React and Next.js product surfaces, caching, and platform reliability while partnering with Product, editorial stakeholders, and other engineers. The role will also contribute to the AI\-powered Hyperlocal content experience. Cloud delivery, CI/CD, and operational reliability are important parts of the work, but the role is not primarily a DevOps position. What You’ll Do: Full\-Stack Product Development* Build and expand consumer\-facing features across the frontend and backend. * Contribute to React and Next.js features, especially when work spans both sides of a product feature. * Own full\-stack work from technical design through testing, release, and production support. Backend Systems \& APIs* Design, build, and scale backend services and APIs supporting the News \& Insights platform. * Develop and maintain Node.js and TypeScript services, GraphQL schemas, persisted queries, and RESTful APIs. * Own server\-side data flows and make sound decisions around service boundaries, performance, and maintainability. Platform Performance \& Reliability* Improve caching and delivery strategies, including CDN or edge caching, object caching, and incremental rendering. * Contribute to logging, monitoring, alerting, incident response, and production reliability. * Support automated testing, CI/CD, and safe, repeatable releases in partnership with platform and infrastructure teams. Hyperlocal \& Collaboration* Contribute to the backend services, integrations, and data flows supporting the AI\-powered Hyperlocal content platform. * Work closely with Product, editorial stakeholders, and engineering partners to shape technical priorities. * Communicate technical trade\-offs clearly and contribute to design discussions, code reviews, Agile ceremonies, and roadmap planning. What You'll Bring:* 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong backend foundation and meaningful frontend experience. * Experience owning full\-stack features or product areas from design through production. * Strong JavaScript or TypeScript experience; Node.js is strongly preferred. * Experience building frontend features with React, Next.js, or a comparable modern framework. * Experience designing and operating RESTful APIs, GraphQL APIs, or comparable service interfaces. * Experience with automated testing, production troubleshooting, and reliability\-focused engineering decisions. * Familiarity with cloud deployment, CI/CD, AWS, or comparable platform practices. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Technical Skills* Frontend: React, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frontend testing. * Backend: Node.js, GraphQL, REST APIs, service integrations, and data modeling. * Performance: CDN or edge caching, object caching, application caching, and incremental rendering. * Platform: AWS, CI/CD, containerized deployments, logging, monitoring, and incident response. * AI and content systems: Practical use of AI coding tools; experience with content, publishing, media, SEO, or localized content systems is helpful. Direct WordPress experience is not required. More important is the ability to work effectively across frontend and backend systems and contribute to a high\-traffic consumer platform. How We Reward You: Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com® Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow. Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - ai automation medical billing platform
jobs.description: PLEASE NOTE: This role is Hybrid \- Remote with occasional travel to the come in East Dallas. A few days per year.. This role will report directly to the CTO with direct interaction of the Founder / CEO. There is no work sponsorship or relocation assistance offered for this role. We are seeking a highly motivated and innovative Senior Software Engineer to join our dynamic team, focusing on developing and enhancing our cutting\-edge Medical Billing Automation SaaS platform. This role offers an exciting opportunity to leverage advanced technologies such as Python, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Large Language Models (LLMs), and Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) to revolutionize healthcare billing processes. As a key contributor, you will drive the design, development, and deployment of scalable, reliable solutions that streamline medical billing workflows, improve accuracy, and enhance user experience. Join us in transforming healthcare technology with your expertise and passion for software engineering! **Duties** * Lead the development of backend systems using Python, ensuring robust integration with AI models, LLMs, and EDI protocols to automate complex billing tasks. * Design and implement scalable microservices architectures utilizing cloud infrastructure such as AWS or Azure to support high\-volume data processing. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to develop RESTful APIs and web services that facilitate seamless communication between components and external systems. * Develop intuitive front\-end interfaces with React, Angular, or similar frameworks to improve usability for end\-users managing billing workflows. * Apply system design principles to create efficient database schemas using relational databases like SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL, as well as NoSQL options like MongoDB. * Implement rigorous testing strategies including unit testing, integration testing, and debugging to ensure high\-quality deliverables aligned with SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle) standards. * Participate actively in Agile software development practices such as Scrum or Kanban, contributing to sprint planning, stand\-ups, and continuous improvement initiatives. **Skills** * Extensive experience with Python programming language for backend development and AI integration. * Strong knowledge of AI technologies including Large Language Models (LLMs) and their application in automation solutions. * Proficiency in EDI standards and protocols essential for healthcare data exchange processes. * Technical Skills * **Expert\-level Python for ETL/ELT pipelines and automation, including libraries such as pandas, pydantic, and SQLAlchemy.** Production experience with a workflow orchestration platform such as Prefect, Airflow, or Dagster. * **Strong SQL fluency across relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake); familiarity with dbt or similar transformation tooling.** Disciplined testing and delivery practices: pytest or equivalent, continuous integration (GitHub Actions or similar), Docker, and Git\-based code review. * **Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure and services, Azure preferred.** Effective, verified use of AI\-assisted development tools as part of daily engineering practice Join us to be part of a forward\-thinking team dedicated to transforming healthcare billing through innovative AI automation software solutions! Your expertise will directly impact the efficiency and accuracy of medical billing processes worldwide while advancing your career in a fast\-paced technological environment. Pay: $130,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Fort Worth, TX 76104

jobs.description: **Job Description** Renesas Electronics America, Inc. is looking for a Data Traceability Engineer to support the development and maintenance of data traceability solutions with artificial intelligence and analytics applications. This entry\-level role works with Customer Quality, Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to help organize, connect, and validate data used to improve product quality, customer insights, and operational decision\-making. The successful candidate will apply foundational skills in data engineering, AI/ML concepts, and software development to support data lineage, metadata management, dataset quality, and end\-to\-end traceability. The role provides hands\-on learning opportunities under the guidance of experienced engineers. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. You will drive Renesas system solutions and collaborate closely with Sales, Channel Marketing, Product Groups, and the System Architects to formulate and execute strategic plans to expand growth in various application segments. **Responsibilities** * Customer Engagement \& Opportunity Development * Engage with customers to drive solution level solutions to secure design wins and drive revenue growth. * Engage with channel partners and customers to identify additional growth opportunities * Orchestrate Business Units, Sales, and FAE’s in solutions promotion and business development activities. * Establish and nurture trusting and productive relationships with key technical and procurement stakeholders in the infrastructure customer base. * Understand market and customer requirements and work with Product Groups to define product requirements and improve product roadmaps. * Identify channel opportunities and collaborate with FAE’s, Sales and channel partners to attack these opportunities. * Research and monitor competition, market dynamics and design windows, and provide recommendations on required responses and/or actions. * Prepare and continuously refine customer presentations to best communicate our value proposition. Ensure customer facing documents effectively communicate desired messages to maximize impact. * Define and develop product collaterals, competitive analysis, customer presentations and field training material. **Qualifications** * 10\+ years of experience in business development, field applications engineering, marketing, or related roles. * Deep understanding of semiconductors and end\-application solution understanding. MCU/MPU product marketing and applications experience is a plus. * Experience with channel sales combined with a proven ability to follow up on leads and build relationships in the field. * Strong strategic thinking, analytical abilities, and communication skills. Capable of conveying complex concepts clearly, concisely, and effectively. * Ability to work effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional environment, collaborating seamlessly with teams across multiple offices worldwide. **Education** * BSEE or related fields. MSEE or MBA is a plus. **Additional Information** Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us? jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Warehouse Automation and Controls
jobs.description: **About Us:** ------------- Rent the Runway (RTR) is transforming the way we get dressed by pioneering the world's first Closet in the Cloud. Founded in 2009, RTR has disrupted the $2\.4 trillion fashion industry by inspiring women with a more joyful, sustainable and financially\-savvy way to feel their best every day. As the ultimate destination for circular fashion, the brand now offers infinite points of access to its shared closet via a fully customizable subscription to fashion, one\-time rental or ownership. RTR offers designer apparel and accessories from hundreds of brand partners and has built in\-house proprietary technology and a one\-of\-a\-kind reverse logistics operation. RTR has been named to CNBC's "Disruptor 50" five times in ten years, and has been placed on Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies list multiple times. **About the Job:** ------------------ The Sr. Engineer, Warehouse Automation and Controls is an engineering role with real decision\-making authority. They will lead the design, development, and execution of multiple complex automation engineering projects and maintain their standards across Rent the Runway's fulfillment infrastructure. This role combines technical expertise with strategic project management, requiring subject matter knowledge of material handling systems, garment processing automation, conveyor systems, barcode scanning equipment, and other integrated operational infrastructure. The role drives technical excellence across multidisciplinary teams, providing engineering leadership and establishing best\-in\-class design, execution, and management standards. They will manage automation vendor partnerships, manage project budgets and operational expenditures, and ensure all projects and systems meet rigorous safety, quality, and timeline requirements. The role will drive continuous improvement initiatives, establish data\-driven performance metrics, and maintain unwavering focus on operational excellence. This role will need to be equally comfortable diving deep into technical specifications and CAD design as they navigate stakeholder relationships and executive communications. They will need to communicate clearly and persuasively, thrive on solving complex technical problems, and collaborate naturally across organizational boundaries. They are energized by the thought of turning innovative ideas into scalable solutions, and do not shy away from a challenge. This Sr. Engineer has a bias for action and leads by example by demonstrating a willingness to dive in, roll up their sleeves and help in any situation. **What You'll Do:** * Own the delivery of multiple automation projects in parallel managing timelines, equipment vendors, and system integration contractors to the operation on time, in budget, and at the targeted performance * Determine how automation lines are configured, evaluate and select automation technologies, and develop technical specifications for existing and new equipment * Maintain a high level of communication with cross\-functional teams and partners; influence stakeholders at all levels to prioritize project requirements * Develop and execute comprehensive testing and commissioning plans (FAT, SAT), including site preparation, installation oversight, operator training, and performance validation ensuring functional specifications, design verification plans, and test procedures are written to maintain engineering rigor supporting GMP, HACCP, and SQF requirements * Establish and enforce standards for PLC program version control, backup, and as\-built documentation * Manage vendor relationships, component procurement, and supply chain integration to support operational timelines * Troubleshooting, analysis and problem resolution of Mechatronics systems and hardware (PLC, Io, Communications cards, etc.) * Own, manage, and scale IoT Dashboard, Digital Twin, and monitoring across all equipment * Bring subject matter expertise in material handling systems, automation equipment, conveyor systems, and large, complex integrated systems design and integration * Ensuring development and debugging of embedded systems, sensors, and automation controllers for reliable system performance * Overseeing simulation, evaluation, testing, and validation of robotic and electromechanical systems against performance and safety standards * Provide frequent on\-site oversight of installation, construction, and commissioning activities * Investigate recurring faults and downtime events, determine root cause, and design corrective actions driving performance and process changes based on lean initiatives to drive operational efficiency and continuous improvement (FMEA, etc.) * Develop and maintain standardized documentation for technical SOPs, and equipment best practice protocols * Provide technical guidance on complex engineering issues using analytical techniques, simulation, ROI analysis, and cost/benefit analysis * This role requires approximately 25% availability  budgets, timelines, and demonstrated ability to influence without authority and lead cross functional technical and nontechnical teams; PMP or PRINCE2 certification preferred * Experience leading equipment commissioning projects from specification to operational turnover, managing vendor performance and inspect work quality to ensure adherence to safety and engineering standards * Proficiency with VFDs, servo systems, HMIs, and industrial networks * Subject matter expertise in material handling systems, automation equipment, and large\-scale integrated operational infrastructure * Proficiency in design software (AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Bluebeam, or equivalent) and familiarity with simulation tools (FEA, motion analysis) * Experience with TPM, Kaizen, and Lean Manufacturing techniques; certification preferred * Experience building and managing project budgets, strong financial acumen and cost\-benefit analysis skills * Experience with developing standard operating procedures and equipment and systems design specifications * Experience implementing automation, digitalization, or AI\-enabled operational improvements * Hands\-on experience with ML/AI technologies * Must operate with a sense of urgency, accountability, and have attention to detail * Strong written and verbal communication; forward\-thinkers with the ability to articulate point of view and improve processes * Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making capabilities; provide strong statistical analysis and data storytelling skills across various levels * Commitment to safety, quality, and employee wellbeing in all aspects of work * Background in fulfillment center operations, warehouse automation, or reverse logistics a plus * Ability to work flex shifts, hours, nights and weekends as business dictates **Benefits:** At Rent the Runway, we're committed to the wellbeing of our employees, and aim to create a workplace that fosters both personal and professional growth. Our inclusive benefits include, but are not limited to: * Paid Time Off, including vacation, paid bereavement, and family sick leave \- every employee needs time to take care of themselves and their family. * Universal Paid Parental Leave for both parents \+ flexible return to work program \- because we know your newest family member(s) deserve your undivided attention. * Paid Sabbatical after 5 years of continuous service \- Unplug, recharge, and have some fun! * Exclusive employee subscription and rental discounts \- to ensure you experience the magic of renting the runway (and give us valued feedback!). * Comprehensive health, vision, dental, FSA and dependent care from day 1 of employment \- Your health comes first, and we've got you covered. * 401(k) match \- an investment in your future. * Company\-wide events and outings \- our team spirit is no joke \- we know how to have fun! *Rent the Runway is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with applicable law, we prohibit discrimination against any applicant or employee based on any legally\-recognized basis, including, but not limited to: race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, age (40 and over), national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), veteran status, uniformed service member status or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.* \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ The anticipated base salary for this position is $160,000 \- $180,000\.00\. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including without limitation, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held. By submitting your application below, you agree that you have read and acknowledge Rent the Runway's Candidate Privacy Policy, found here.

jobs.title: Senior Network Security Engineer
jobs.description: *Rockland Trust is a full\-service commercial bank and financial services company committed to helping our neighbors reach their financial goals. Founded in 1907 and headquartered in Massachusetts, we proudly serve individuals, families, and businesses throughout New England with a strong emphasis on personal relationships, local decision making, and community impact.* *With a broad range of banking, wealth management, and investment solutions, Rockland Trust combines the resources of a growing financial institution with the personalized service of a community bank. Our long\-standing philosophy,* ***Where Each Relationship Matters®,*** *guides how we work with our customers, colleagues, and communities every day.* *At Rockland Trust, our employees are at the heart of our success. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and values driven culture that encourages professional growth, innovation, and work life balance. We are deeply committed to community involvement, financial education, and creating a workplace where individuals can build meaningful, long\-term careers.* Rockland Trust is hiring a **Senior Security Engineer** . Reporting to the Manager of Security Engineering, this role will lead the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of security solutions that protect the Bank's data, systems, applications, and cloud environments. This role requires expertise across multiple security domains, including network security, endpoint protection, security monitoring, threat detection and response, identity and access management, privileged access management, cloud security, data protection, email security, and Zero Trust architectures. The Senior Security Engineer will lead strategic security initiatives, enhance the organization's security posture, and support Security Operations Center (SOC) functions through advanced monitoring, threat hunting, incident response, and security automation. This position requires the ability to be on call and available 24x7 as needed to support the organization during security incidents, critical upgrades, or other time\-sensitive issues, ensuring continuous protection of the organization's systems, applications, and data. The Senior Security Engineer collaborates closely with Network Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud Operations, Security Operations, Application Development, Risk, and Compliance teams to identify risks, implement security controls, and drive enterprise\-wide security initiatives. This role also serves as a mentor and technical leader for junior team members. **MAJOR ACCOUNTABILITIES / CRITICAL RESPONSIBILITIES** **Security Architecture \& Engineering** * Provide technical leadership for the design, deployment, and lifecycle management of enterprise security technologies. * Develop and maintain secure architectures for on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments utilizing Zero Trust principles. * Design, implement, and maintain next\-generation network security controls, secure remote access solutions, and cloud\-delivered security services. * Develop and maintain secure configurations for security platforms, firewalls, security monitoring tools, identity services, and access controls. * Design and implement network segmentation and micro\-segmentation strategies to limit lateral movement and reduce organizational risk. * Partner with infrastructure and application teams to ensure secure system and application architectures. **Threat Detection, Security Operations \& Incident Response** * Act as a senior technical resource for security incident response efforts, threat containment, remediation, and post\-incident reviews. * Partner with SOC personnel to improve threat detection, monitoring, alerting, and response capabilities. * Develop and maintain SIEM use cases, correlation rules, dashboards, security metrics, and automated response workflows. * Conduct proactive threat hunting activities leveraging endpoint, network, cloud, and security telemetry sources. * Support and enhance endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR) capabilities across the enterprise. * Lead investigations related to malware, phishing, insider threats, unauthorized access, and advanced persistent threats. **Identity, Privileged Access \& Zero Trust** * Lead the implementation and ongoing management of identity security, identity governance, and privileged access management controls. * Ensure least\-privilege access principles are implemented across critical systems and applications. * Support Zero Trust initiatives focused on identity\-centric security, continuous verification, and secure access controls. * Review and enhance authentication, authorization, and privileged account management processes. **Cloud, Data \& Endpoint Security** * Lead implementation and management of cloud security solutions supporting hybrid and multi\-cloud environments. * Oversee endpoint security technologies, ensuring effective prevention, detection, and response capabilities. * Implement and ma t role. * Demonstrated expertise across network security, cloud security, endpoint security, identity security, privileged access management, data protection, and threat detection technologies. * Hands\-on experience administering and supporting SIEM, EDR/XDR, security monitoring, and SOC technologies. * Strong knowledge of Zero Trust security principles and enterprise security architecture frameworks. * Experience designing and implementing network segmentation or micro\-segmentation solutions within enterprise environments. * Experience securing cloud\-based applications, infrastructure, and SaaS environments. * Expertise with privileged access management, identity governance, Active Directory, authentication services, and access control technologies. * Strong understanding of email security, data protection, DLP, insider risk management, and information governance concepts. * Proven experience leading major security incidents, investigations, and remediation efforts. * Strong knowledge of security frameworks and standards such as NIST and CIS Controls. * Excellent communication, documentation, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or equivalent are strongly preferred. * **ADDITIONAL SKILLS** **Security Platforms:** CrowdStrike Falcon, CyberArk PAM, Proofpoint, Netskope, Qualys VMDR, Palo Alto Networks, Microsoft Defender Suite **Security Operations:** SIEM, SOC Operations, Threat Hunting, Incident Response, Detection Engineering, Security Monitoring, SOAR, EDR/XDR **Identity \& Access Security:** Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Identity Governance (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), MFA, SSO, Conditional Access, Zero Trust **Cloud \& Data Security:** Azure Security, Microsoft 365 Security, CASB, SSE, ZTNA, DLP, Information Protection, Data Classification, Data Access Governance, Insider Risk Management, Hybrid Cloud Security **Network Security:** Network Segmentation, Micro\-Segmentation, IDS/IPS, VPN Technologies, Secure Remote Access, Firewall Management **Governance \& Risk:** NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls, Vulnerability Management, Security Architecture Reviews, Risk Assessments, Compliance Support **Leadership \& Professional Skills:** Technical Leadership, Cross\-Functional Collaboration, Project Leadership, Technical Mentoring, Process Improvement, Strategic Planning, Technical Documentation ***Benefits \& Culture*** *Our goal is to offer our colleagues the most generous benefits package possible. We provide a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to support your health, financial security, and overall, well\-being. Benefits include competitive compensation with performance\-based incentive awards, health, and dental insurance, a 401(k) and DC retirement plan, LTD and life insurance, paid vacation, day care reimbursement, tuition assistance for undergraduate and graduate programs, an award\-winning wellness program, and much more!* *At Rockland Trust, you’ll find a respectful and inclusive environment where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.* ***Pay Transparency*** *Compensation for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including skills, experience, education, and internal equity. The salary range posted reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the range for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary. In addition to base salary, certain positions may be eligible for additional compensation, including commissions, incentive awards, or stipends.* ***Accessibility \& Accommodations*** *We are committed to providing reasonable accommodation to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their roles.*

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer - Computer Vision
jobs.description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description ### **Position Summary:** Rockwell Automation is building FT Analytics VisionAI, a machine vision and visual inspection into the Portfolio. You will be the senior technical authority for the vision models behind that capability \- the detection, classification, and anomaly models that decide whether a part passes or fails on a line running at production rate, on hardware sitting next to a Logix controller. This is a hands\-on role. You will set the modeling direction, own the evaluation methodology that says whether a model is good enough to ship, and work directly with manufacturing customers on what their defects actually look like. Accuracy targets here are set by a customer's scrap rate and cycle time, not by a benchmark leaderboard. You will build in an AI\-first engineering environment \- coding agents running inside a harness we own, evals gating AI\-generated changes, GitHub Copilot Enterprise and Claude in the daily loop, and MCP\-based tooling that lets agents reach real build, test, and telemetry systems under human\-in\-the\-loop review. You will also help define what eval\-driven development means for model code specifically, where the regression suite gates a model release the way a test suite gates a build. This role will have a remote schedule and will report to the Director, Software Engineering. ### **Your Responsibilities:** * Own the modeling approach for visual inspection \- architecture selection, training strategy, and the accuracy, latency, and false\-reject targets each deployed model must hit. * Define and maintain the evaluation methodology and regression suite that gates a model release, including how labeled data is versioned, sampled, and audited. * Optimize models for constrained edge targets: quantization, runtime selection, and throughput tuning against real camera and controller timing budgets. * Own drift detection, retraining triggers, and production model monitoring across deployed customer installations. * Partner with customers and application engineers on feasibility, data collection strategy, and acceptance criteria for new inspection applications. * Set the technical bar for the ML discipline through design review, mentoring, and written architecture guidance. * Apply agents and evals to the ML workflow itself \- dataset triage, failure\-mode summarization, experiment scaffolding \- and measure whether they actually improved cycle time. ### **The Essentials \- You Will Have:** * Bachelor's Degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience. * Legal authorization to work in the US is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. ### **The Preferred \- You Might Also Have:** * Typically requires 8\+ years of related experience in a software product development environment. * Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical discipline. * Experience taking machine learning models from research through to production deployment * Experience with deep learning for computer vision \- detection, classification, segmentation, or anomaly detection * Experience deploying vision models to edge or embedded targets under fixed latency budgets. * Depth in PyTorch or TensorFlow, and in the tooling around dataset versioning, labeling quality, and experiment tracking. * Experience with model optimization techniques \- quantization, pruning, distillation, TensorRT or ONNX Runtime. * Direct customer\-facing technical experience: scoping applications, setting acceptance criteria, and defending a model's limits. * Exposure to industrial or manufacturing environments, machine vision hardware, or PLC\-based control systems. * Experience building evaluation harnesses that let a team ship model changes with confidence. ### **What We Offer:** * Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision * 401k * Paid Time off * Parental and Caregiver Leave * Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life. * To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com. This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation. For this role, the Base Salary Compensation is from $146,880\.00 \- 220,320\.00 USD with an annual target bonus of 8% of base salary. Our company benefits for the US can be found here . jobs.title: Director, Data and Platform
jobs.description: We are a healthcare technology company that provides platforms and solutions to improve the management and access of cost\-effective pharmacy benefits. Our technology helps enterprise and partnership clients simplify their businesses and helps consumers save on prescriptions. As a leader in SaaS technology for healthcare, we offer innovative solutions with integrated intelligence on a single enterprise platform that connects the pharmacy ecosystem. With our expertise and modern, modular platform, our partners use real\-time data to transform their business performance and optimize their innovative models in the marketplace. **Position Summary** We're adding a director of data and platform architecture to a small, high\-leverage AI engineering team. You'll own the full data architecture end to end: how data lands in our systems, how it moves through ETL and transformation, and how it ultimately reaches stakeholders through extracts and dashboards. You'll also own devops and infrastructure for the AI engineering team, meaning you decide how everything gets built, deployed, and kept running. You'll set that architecture and build it yourself. This is a hands\-on keyboard role, even at the director level. This role comes with direct reports from the start. You'll build and lead the team as it grows, while staying close enough to the work to keep shipping code yourself. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Own the data architecture end to end, from the moment data lands in our systems through ETL and transformation, extracts, and the dashboards stakeholders rely on. * Own devops and infrastructure for the AI engineering team end to end. Design and own the platform architecture underlying our AI engineering systems, from ingestion through serving. * Set technical direction and standards for data infrastructure, pipelines, ETL and transformation logic, and platform reliability. * Design the extract and reporting layer so downstream dashboards and analytics are accurate, timely, and trusted. * Build the systems and infrastructure you design, and make them production grade: deployable, observable, and stable enough to run without hand holding. * Write and ship code yourself. * Build and lead the data and platform team as it grows, from hiring through day\-to\-day direction. * Mentor engineers on architecture, data design, devops, and/or platform thinking. * Communicate tradeoffs clearly to engineers, other architects, and leadership. Turn complex systems into decisions people can act on. * Partner with AI engineering leadership to align platform investments with product and research priorities. * Translate business and executive priorities into data strategy and architecture decisions, so technical investments map directly to what the business needs next. You own the outcome of those decisions. **Education/Experience/Competencies** * 8\+ years architecting and building platforms in production. Not a hard cutoff: strong candidates with less experience can still be considered. * Proven, hands\-on experience owning data architecture end to end, including ingestion, ETL and transformation, extracts, and the reporting or BI layer. * Proven, hands\-on devops experience: you build, deploy, and operate the systems and infrastructure you design, and what you ship performs in production at scale. * A track record of writing and shipping production code yourself, not just producing diagrams and design documents. * Hands\-on depth across the modern data stack: big data/distributed processing (e.g., Spark, Kafka), NoSQL and document stores (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB), data warehousing (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery), and high\-throughput transactional databases (Postgres, MySQL) with rigorous PHI/PII handling and detection practices. * Hands\-on experience with devops tooling and practices: GitOps workflows, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent). * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. You translate complex architecture decisions into terms engineers, other architects, and non\-technical leadership can act on, and you do it consistently, not just in big reviews. You work across teams by default, aligning platform and data decisions with product, research, and business priorities rather than building in isolation. * Experience mentoring engineers on architecture, data design, devops, and/or platform thinking. * Prior experience building and leading a team, or clear readiness to take on direct reports. * Comfort working in a small, fast\-moving team where you'll wear multiple hats. **Bonus Qualifications** * Experience architecting data platforms that support AI or ML workloads. * Experience with vector databases for AI/ML retrieval (e.g., Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate). * Experience in healthcare, pharmacy benefits, or another regulated data environment. * Experience standing up data platforms from scratch (greenfield), not just extending or migrating existing systems. Our recruitment process is free from discriminatory hiring practices and all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, ancestry, age, or national origin. Neither will qualified applicants be discriminated against on the basis of disability or protected veteran status. We believe in the strength of the collaboration, creativity and sense of community a diverse workforce brings.

jobs.title: Electrical Inspector - 8 Month Contract
jobs.description: **Company Description** *We are SGS – the world’s leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for quality and integrity. Our 98,000 employees operate a network of 2,650 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.* **Job Description** SGS is seeking an Experienced Electrical Inspector (Contract) to support a carbon capture and storage (CCS) project in the **Muncie / Union City area of Indiana**. The project is currently in the civil construction phase. Current work includes piling for the compressor building, pipe rack, cooling tower, MCC building, cable tray steel, and miscellaneous supports extending toward the wellhead. Position Summary The Electrical Inspector will represent the owner's side, inspecting the work performed by third\-party contractors. The role requires practical proficiency in electrical systems as well as instrumentation and controls (IC\&E), with the ability to identify discrepancies, provide knowledgeable technical feedback, complete daily reports, and interface directly with contractor management. The inspector will also work with multiple equipment vendors and the project startup and commissioning team. Although a commissioning team will be assigned, the inspector must understand how to diagnose electrical, valving, and instrumentation issues and help reduce delays when technical questions arise. The assignment is expected to begin once the appropriate candidate is identified and is tentatively expected to continue through to June 2027\. Potential future work may be available on subsequent projects. The ideal candidate is a practical, experienced electrical inspector with solid instrumentation and controls knowledge. They can work confidently with contractors, vendors, and startup personnel; understand NEC requirements; identify drawing and field discrepancies; troubleshoot technical issues; and produce clear daily reports. Key Responsibilities * Inspect third\-party contractors’ electrical, instrumentation, and controls work. * Monitor installation activities and verify that work complies with approved drawings, specifications, project requirements, and the National Electrical Code (NEC). * Review drawings and identify discrepancies, conflicts, or constructability concerns, and provide knowledgeable feedback to the project team. * Inspect electrical systems and related equipment, including MCCs, cable tray systems, associated steel and supports, and electrical work connected to project buildings and the wellhead area. * Apply instrumentation and controls knowledge when reviewing field installations and diagnosing valving or instrumentation concerns. * Work with multiple vendors and coordinate with the startup and commissioning team. * Interface with contractor management regarding inspection findings, field issues, quality concerns, and required follow\-up. * Complete accurate daily reports documenting work progress, inspection activities, observations, deficiencies, and contractor interactions. * Help resolve field issues efficiently by using existing electrical and IC\&E knowledge rather than relying entirely on outside resources. * Maintain a consistent field presence and support project activities through construction, startup, and commissioning. **Qualifications** Required Experience \& Knowledge * Technical Diploma or trade certification in a related field (Electrical/Mechanical Journeyman, Millwright etc.); and/or carries a certificate as one of the discipline Engineers, Technicians, Journeyman Red Seal or Specialists designation. * Demonstrated inspection experience involving industrial electrical systems. * Proficiency in instrumentation, controls, and electrical systems (IC\&E). * Experience with industrial instrumentation and controls from manufacturers (For instrumentation, Rosemount and for controls, Allen Bradley would be a definitive asset). * Experience supporting equipment startup or commissioning activities. * Prior owner\-representative or third\-party inspection experience is needed. * Experience on carbon capture, energy, industrial, process, or similar construction projects. * Strong working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC). * Candidates may come from an inspection, engineering, technical, or field electrical background, provided they can demonstrate the required proficiency and relevant experience. * Ability to read and review electrical and instrumentation drawings, recognize discrepancies, and provide practical technical feedback. * Experience working with contractors, contractor management, equipment vendors, and project or startup teams. * Ability to diagnose or help troubleshoot electrical, valving, controls, and instrumentation issues. * Strong written communication and daily reporting skills. * Ability to work independently and communicate clearly with field personnel and project stakeholders. * Broad vendor exposure that allows the inspector to work effectively across different equipment and control platforms. **Schedule, Location \& Travel Requirements** * Site\-based assignment in the Muncie / Union City area of Indiana. * Full\-time, Monday through Friday schedule, with potential Saturday work depending on project schedule and urgency. Shift Schedule: Monday to Friday 7 am to 5 pm * Availability to remain at or relocate near the project site for the duration of the assignment is preferred. * The successful candidate must provide their own transportation to and from the worksite; a company truck is not provided. * A per diem and milage will be paid depending on the location of the contractor * The position will be for approximatively 8 months or until the site is in service. **Additional Information** *SGS is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and as such we recruit, hire, train, and promote persons in all job classifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetics, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristics protected by law.* *To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily with or without reasonable accommodations. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities required.* *This job description should not be construed as an exhaustive statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements, but a general description of the job. Nothing contained herein restricts the company’s rights to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.* *If you are applying for a position within the United States and you have difficulty completing the on\-line employment application because of a disability, please call 201\-508\-3149 for assistance and leave a message. You will receive a callback. Please note, this phone number is not for general employment information but is only for individuals who are experiencing difficulty applying for a position due to a disability.*

to coordinate and collaborate across multiple disciplines **Preferred Qualifications** * Associate degree or technical training in drafting, architecture, engineering technology, or a related field * jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer, Growth Product Engineering
jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About the role:** Are you a platform engineer who wants to build the foundation that lets an entire growth product engineering organization move faster? At Samsara, we are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join Growth Product \& Engineering and own the platform our growth and marketing teams build on. As we push toward AI\-assisted and agentic development, our velocity is increasingly bottlenecked not by feature work but by foundational gaps in infrastructure, security, and tooling. These initiatives cut across every team, but no single person owns them today. You will. This is a hands\-on, high\-leverage role. You will design the hardened CI/CD pipeline that makes agent\-written code safe to ship, migrate hand\-built AWS resources to Infrastructure as Code, isolate production and pre\-production workloads into properly separated accounts, centralize logging and monitoring, and give every engineer a paved path to self\-service infrastructure. Our stack includes Python, JavaScript (Vue), AWS, and GitHub Actions (workflow) API with a growing surface of serverless and container based services and internally hosted applications. The core principle behind this work: when a human writes a PR, the human is the safety net; when an AI agent writes a PR, the pipeline is the safety net. Raising that bar is the prerequisite for scaling AI\-assisted development safely, and it is the single highest\-leverage investment we can make in engineering velocity. If that excites you, we would love to talk. **This role is open to candidates residing in the US** **except** **the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.** #### **You should apply if:** * You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real\-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * You are energized by leverage: You would rather build the systems that prevent an entire class of problems than fix the same problem ten times. * You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role will not be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development and countless opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment. * You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high\-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. #### **In this role, you will:** * Own the CI/CD foundation for AI\-assisted and agentic development: hardened pipeline gates, high test coverage, mutation and end\-to\-end tests, blocking security scans, performance and cost regression guards, and progressive delivery with automated rollback. * Give engineers a fast, safe inner loop with ephemeral per\-PR environments and local tooling, including isolated databases seeded from realistic data. * Build centralized logging, monitoring, and alerting across our AWS footprint so every team has visibility and bad deployments roll back automatically. * Lead security engineering: remediate vulnerabilities, establish secure\-by\-default patterns, and automate code scanning, secrets management, and access control. * Migrate hand\-built AWS resources to Infrastructure as Code, separate production and pre\-production accounts, and stand up tested backup and disaster recovery with clear RTO and RPO targets. * Build paved\-path, self\-service tooling and standardized blue/green, canary, and feature\-flag releases, while mentoring engineers and role modeling Samsara's cultural principles as we scale. * Build and operate AI agents for SRE work: automated alert triage, incident investigation, and safe self\-healing remediation, so on\-call toil jobs.title: Technical Trainer - North Phoenix
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** The Technical Trainer is responsible for developing and delivering technical training programs for SCREEN SPE USA customers, field service engineers, installers, technical support personnel, engineering teams, and other stakeholders. This hands\-on role ensures users of SCREEN equipment have the knowledge and skills necessary to safely operate, maintain, troubleshoot, and support SCREEN products. The trainer will conduct classroom, laboratory, and field\-based instruction while partnering with engineering, applications, service, and product teams to maintain technical accuracy and alignment with evolving product capabilities. This position reports to the Technical Training Manager. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, and deliver technical training courses on SCREEN equipment. * Conduct hands\-on training in classrooms, labs, and customer fab environments. * Evaluate training effectiveness and implement improvements based on feedback and performance metrics. * Collaborate with engineering, field service, and product teams to ensure training content reflects current product configurations and best practices. * Support onboarding of new field service engineers and customer personnel. **Training Delivery:** * Deliver instructor\-led technical training on SCREEN equipment, systems, software, maintenance procedures, and troubleshooting methods. * Conduct classroom, laboratory, cleanroom, and customer site training activities. * Serve as a subject matter expert for assigned SCREEN product lines. **Workforce Development:** * Support onboarding and qualification of new Field Service Engineers, installers, and Technical Support personnel. * Administer certification exams, practical assessments, and qualification activities. * Provide technical coaching and mentoring to trainees. **Curriculum Maintenance:** * Maintain training materials to reflect equipment revisions, software updates, engineering changes, and field lessons learned. * Develop hands\-on exercises, troubleshooting scenarios, and laboratory activities that reinforce technical competencies. **Required Skills/Abilities:** * Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes and SCREEN’s equipment portfolio (FC, SU, SS, LA series tools). * Ability to effectively teach and communicate complex technical concepts to both new and experienced engineers. * Excellent communication, presentation, and classroom facilitation skills. * Proficiency with digital training tools. * Familiarity with SEMI standards, and cleanroom protocols. * Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills. * Ability to diagnose mechanical, electrical, software, and process\-related equipment issues. * Ability to work independently and manage multiple training priorities. * Ability to travel to customer sites domestically and internationally as needed. * Experience working with Japanese counterparts. **Success Metrics:** * Training completion and certification rates. * Trainee evaluation and feedback scores. * Successful qualification of new hires. * Training content accuracy and currency. * Customer satisfaction with training delivery. * Compliance with global training standards and certification requirements. **Education and Experience:** * Associate's degree or equivalent technical experience in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Semiconductor Technology, or a related field. * 5\+ years of experience supporting semiconductor capital equipment as a Field Service Engineer, Applications Engineer, Product Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, or similar technical role. * Previous experience delivering technical training, mentoring, coaching, or leading structured OJT programs preferred. * Experience supporting SCREEN semiconductor equipment strongly preferred. * Experience working directly with customers in semiconductor manufacturing environments preferred.
