jobs.title: R&D Engineering Technician
jobs.description: **About Subsense** Subsense is a deep\-tech company developing the world’s first non\-surgical, bidirectional brain\-computer interface powered by plasmonic and magnetoelectric nanoparticles. Our mission is to unlock direct communication between the human brain and AI \- starting with medical applications such as stroke recovery and moving toward cognitive enhancement for healthy users. Headquartered in Palo Alto, Subsense brings together leading scientists and engineers to redefine the future of human–machine interaction.### **The Opportunity** We are seeking a hands\-on R\&D Engineering Laboratory Technician to support our engineering and research teams across electrical, optical, mechanical, and experimental hardware development. This role keeps the engineering laboratory running: preparing test setups, assembling and modifying prototype hardware, fabricating fixtures, managing equipment and component inventory, and making sure engineers and scientists have the tools and materials they need to execute experiments efficiently. The ideal candidate is highly hands\-on, organized, and detail\-oriented — equally comfortable reworking a 0402 resistor under a microscope, aligning a photodiode on an optical bench, and machining or 3D\-printing a fixture to hold it all together. You will work directly with electrical, optical, mechanical, and bioengineering teams in a fast\-paced R\&D environment where priorities shift quickly. This person will own day\-to\-day engineering laboratory organization, equipment tracking, and component inventory, while providing direct technical support for prototype assembly, fabrication, soldering, testing, and experimental setup. The position is based on\-site, primarily at our Mountain View laboratory. ### **Key Responsibilities** **Laboratory Operations** * Maintain an organized, functional, and safe engineering laboratory across electrical, optical, and mechanical work areas. * Establish and improve systems for equipment storage, component tracking, and laboratory workflow. * Support laboratory ESD, safety, and equipment\-maintenance practices. **Electrical \& Electronics Support** * Assemble, modify, and rework prototype PCBs and electronic assemblies. * Perform precision soldering and rework of miniature surface\-mount components, including 0201, 0402, 0603, fine\-pitch ICs, QFN, QFP, connectors, LEDs, and photodiodes. * Perform or support BGA soldering and rework, including component replacement, inspection, and troubleshooting. * Use microscopes, hot\-air rework stations, soldering stations, preheaters, and other precision equipment. * Build and modify cables, harnesses, connectors, breakout boards, and test fixtures. * Assist engineers with PCB bring\-up, hardware debugging, electrical measurements, and troubleshooting. * Operate oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power supplies, function generators, logic analyzers, data acquisition systems, LCR meters, optical power meters, and related instrumentation. **Optical Support** * Set up and support optical experiments involving LEDs, lasers, photodiodes, optical sensors, fiber optics, detectors, and filters. * Assist with optical alignment, mounting, and measurement of prototype systems. **Mechanical Fabrication \& Prototyping** * Perform mechanical assembly and rapid prototyping of experimental hardware. * Design and fabricate fixtures, jigs, mounts, and enclosures using 3D printing, laser cutting, and basic machining. * Use hand and power tools safely and accurately. * Interpret CAD drawings and mechanical documentation; troubleshoot mechanical issues in prototype hardware. * Build and modify experimental hardware to meet evolving research requirements. **Experimental \& Research Support** * Set up, run, and tear down experiments for engineers and scientists across disciplines. * Prepare and stage equipment ahead of planned experiments; reproduce previously documented experimental configurations reliably. * Support prototype testing and troubleshoot integrated experimental systems spanning electrical, optical, mechanical, and fluidic subsystems. * Provide direct bench support to scientists and engineers during R\&D experiments. **Instrumentation \& Integrated Systems** * Operate and maintain scientific instrumentation, sensors, and data acquisition systems. * Support pneumatic and fluidic systems used in experimental setups. * Integrate mechanical and electrical subsystems into working test platforms. * Support equipment calibration, preventive maintenance, and basic equipment repair. **Inventory \& Equipment Management** * Maintain accurate inventories of test instruments, tools, fixtures, cables, adapters, and laboratory equipment; track location, availability, maintenance, and calibration status. * Manage electronic, optical, and mechanical component inventory, including semiconductors, passives, connectors, sensors, LEDs, photodiodes, optics, hardware, and prototyping materials. * Work with engineers to identify required components and flag shortages early. * Receive, inspect, label, organize, and store incoming materials; maintain stock levels of commonly used components and consumables. **Documentation \& Continuous Improvement** * Maintain clear documentation of equipment, inventory, test setups, prototype configurations, and laboratory procedures. * Help develop and improve laboratory procedures, organization, and best practices. * Collaborate with engineers and scientists to troubleshoot experimental hardware and improve laboratory workflows. * Support additional engineering laboratory activities as priorities evolve. **What You’ll Bring** **Core** * Hands\-on experience in an electronics, electrical, optical, mechanical, instrumentation, or research laboratory. * Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and accurate record\-keeping. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving instincts across disciplines. * Ability to work independently, anticipate laboratory needs, and proactively keep engineers unblocked. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced R\&D or startup environment where priorities change quickly. **Electrical** * Strong electronics assembly and PCB rework skills. * Experience soldering and inspecting miniature surface\-mount components, including 0201 and fine\-pitch packages, under a microscope. * Ability to read electrical schematics, PCB drawings, and component documentation. * Experience operating common electrical laboratory equipment and setting up electrical experiments. **Mechanical** * Mechanical assembly and rapid prototyping experience. * Experience fabricating fixtures and jigs using 3D printing, laser cutting, or basic machining. * Comfort with hand and power tools and the ability to interpret CAD drawings. **Optical** * Experience working with LEDs, lasers, photodiodes, optical sensors, or fiber optics. * Ability to assemble and troubleshoot optical and electro\-optical test setups. **Experimental \& Inventory** * Experience setting up, running, and documenting laboratory experiments. * Experience managing laboratory equipment, tools, components, or engineering inventory. **Preferred Qualifications** * Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, electrical engineering technology, electronics, electro\-optics, mechanical engineering technology, instrumentation, or a related technical discipline — or equivalent hands\-on experience. * Experience with BGA rework and advanced PCB repair. * Experience with PCB prototyping and hardware bring\-up. * Experience with optical alignment and fiber\-optic systems. * Experience with CAD (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar) and in\-house 3D printing or machining. * Experience with pneumatic, fluidic, or microfluidic systems. * Experience with data acquisition systems or automated test equipment. * Experience with ESD\-controlled laboratory environments. * Experience with laboratory equipment calibration and asset management. * Experience in an R\&D, medical\-device, semiconductor, instrumentation, biotech, or advanced technology environment. * Experience supporting multidisciplinary engineering and scientific teams. *Subsense is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior IT Engineer
jobs.description: Location: Global \- Remote **About Turing** ================ Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high\-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest\-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end\-to\-end agentic AI systems inside mission\-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real\-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com. **Senior IT Engineer** ====================== Join Turing's IT team as a **Senior IT Engineer**, building and running the systems that keep the company productive and secure — identity, devices, SaaS applications, and the automation that ties them together. This is a hands\-on opportunity for an engineer who treats IT as an engineering discipline: automating instead of clicking, building self\-service instead of ticket queues, and partnering closely with security to make the secure path the easy path. You'll own core corporate infrastructure, drive automation across the employee lifecycle, and be the technical backbone that lets the rest of the company work smoothly. **What You'll Work On** ----------------------- * **Own identity and access:** Administer our identity platform (SSO, MFA, provisioning) and integrate it across our SaaS estate, including access provisioning, deprovisioning, and periodic access reviews. * **Manage the device fleet:** Own macOS, Windows, and Linux devices via MDM — imaging, configuration, patching, and compliance. * **Automate the employee lifecycle:** Build automation for onboarding, offboarding, and access management, reducing manual IT toil across the board. * **Administer and integrate SaaS applications:** Own core SaaS tools and build automation and integrations across them, often via APIs and scripting. * **Partner on security:** Work closely with the security team on corporate security controls, endpoint hardening, and least\-privilege access. * **Build internal tooling:** Design self\-service workflows that reduce dependency on ticket queues and manual intervention. * **Drive reliability:** Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure and endpoint issues, and improve monitoring and observability across corporate systems. * **Document and mentor:** Keep systems well documented, and mentor other members of the IT team. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * We expect this level of expertise to be consistent with **5\+ years of experience** in IT engineering, systems administration, or a similar role. * Strong hands\-on experience with **identity providers** (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace) and **MDM tooling**. * Experience administering and integrating **SaaS applications** at scale. * Solid **scripting/automation skills** (Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar) — you automate repetitive work rather than repeat it manually. * Security\-minded, with experience implementing **corporate security controls**. * Strong troubleshooting skills and a **service\-oriented mindset**. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Experience with **infrastructure\-as\-code** and configuration management. * Familiarity with **zero\-trust access** and modern corporate security architecture. * Experience supporting a fast\-growing, remote\-friendly workforce. * Relevant certifications. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- **First few months:** You'll own key corporate systems, have automated meaningful chunks of the employee lifecycle, and be a trusted partner to both employees and the security team. **Values** ---------- * **We are client first:** We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value. * **We work at Start\-Up Speed:** We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection * **We are AI forward:** We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity. **Advantages of joining Turing** -------------------------------- * **Work at the frontier of AI**, helping the world’s leading AI labs improve their most advanced models by building expert datasets, RL environments, and first\-of\-a\-kind benchmarks. * **Contribute to leading\-edge AI research** and showcase your work at top conferences such as ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS. * **Bring frontier AI innovation to the enterprise**, applying lessons learned from leading AI labs to solve real\-world business challenges. * **Collaborate with and learn from exceptional colleagues** with deep AI experience from Google, Meta, Amazon, and other leading technology companies. * **Move at the pace of AI innovation**, with the speed, ownership, and impact of a startup. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Perception Engineer
jobs.description: **Role name: Perception Engineer** **Work Location: DFW, Texas (Onsite)** As a Perception Engineer III , you are responsible for leading the design and development of advanced perception algorithms and sensor integration solutions that drive the performance of clients autonomous vehicle platforms. You operate with a high degree of autonomy, own complex technical processes, and actively mentor junior engineers on the Perception team. **Essential Duties And Responsibilities :** · Lead the design, development, and deployment of perception algorithms for LiDAR, radar, camera, and sensor fusion applications across clients autonomous platforms. · Architect real\-time C\+\+ processing pipelines for object detection, classification, tracking, and sensor fusion in embedded environments. · Define sensor selection criteria, integration standards, and validation processes for new and existing perception systems. · Drive resolution of complex or non\-standard perception failures through root cause analysis and algorithm refinement. · Collaborate cross\-functionally with planning, controls, and systems engineers to align perception outputs with broader autonomy architecture. · Deploy and configure perception systems at customer sites, providing technical leadership during integration. · Mentor Perception Engineers I and II, conducting code reviews and providing technical guidance. · Document system architecture, algorithm design decisions, and lessons learned to build team knowledge. **Essential Education, Work Experience, Job Skills :** · Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field; Master's degree preferred. · 4–7 years of experience developing perception systems for autonomous vehicles or robotics platforms. · Expert proficiency in C\+\+ (C\+\+11 or newer) with demonstrated experience building production\-grade, multithreaded Linux applications. · Proven experience with at least two of the following: LiDAR point cloud processing, automotive radar processing, image processing for object recognition, or sensor fusion and object tracking. · Experience with Robot Operating System (ROS or ROS2\) and DDS or publish\-subscribe messaging architectures. · Strong understanding of machine learning and AI techniques deployed in embedded C\+\+ environments. · Proficiency in Python3 or MATLAB for prototyping and analysis. · Advanced knowledge of linear algebra, probabilistic estimation, and coordinate transformations. **Physical Requirements :** · Ability to remain in a stationary position at a computer workstation constantly throughout the workday. · Ability to constantly operate a computer and other office productivity machinery. · Ability to effectively complete job responsibilities on computer monitors. · Ability to effectively communicate and exchange information in person, via phone, and through other electronic means. · Able to traverse an office environment.
